gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrogs/dgra grogs kyi g.yul sa tshang mar dbyang bskyod byed dgos pa'i nga /kher rkyang ghi lam bya zhig nas bsun skyo'i 'jig rten gyi gyu 9 'dir/'gyo ldog mi shes pa'i bsam gzhig hi klong du 'khyams/da 94gangs slo/

sgrong baspyod/gleng merjod/༄47 mi'irigasakyispyicho gsa'adiraranganyidakyibasamablo'ibaspo larigashi spyod mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs byung dang 'byung bzhin pa ltar/rang re pur rgyal bod rgyal khab chen po 'di nyid kyang go la chung ngu 'di'i yang rtser gzhi grub pa nas bzung skabs re srid 'acadar rig gsum gyis 'dzam gling gi mdun sar steg myong ba dang lan re rgud pa'i mthar yang 〈〈1959——2006〉〉lhung ba byung yod/ yin na'ang mi riḍa 'di nyid kyi tshe srog dus rabs nyer gcig gi de ring bar sa yi go la'i yang thog tu gson por 'tsho gnas thub yod/da dung pha mes tshos gsar bskrun mdzad cing mi thog ring 'phar masding yang dus dbang gis btsan 'og tu gyar ba'i rlabs chen gyi mi riḍa 'di dang / rgyal khab 'di nyid sa gzhi 'di'i steng nam tsam 'chor gnas thub min dang / ji tsam yar rgyas sku nga min gyi 'gag rtsani mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig 'chi gasku na dang / mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i rgyags phye/ rig gnas yar rgyas ji ltar 'thod min la thug yod par sems/ rig gnas yar rgyas kyi gzhi 'dzin sa'ang sgya rtsal rtsom rig gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsom rig gi gar stegs mtho dman las dpog dgos/ de ni dus rabs dang spyi dzargags shig nang bsam chod ba'i grangs tshad dang spus tshad cig yin la/ bsam blo ba ni spyi snu gas shig gi sku da tshad kyi 'byung khungs lags/de dag mi'i rigs spyi sku ngas la dbang zhing / rang cag la mchosan na mdang skyes kyi byis pa tshun bod mi re re yi lde ga tu med pa'i 'gan 'khri zhig yin/ 'on kyang la la ni ma shes pa'i mnar gcadad kyis gdung / la la ni shes kyang tso gas ris 7

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/kyis bslus/ gang ltar nga tsho'i spyi tshogs nang byas pa can la bltod glu len mkhan med la/ ma rungs khog rul la tshar gcod byed mkhan de bas med/ 'di dag gi so mtshams 'byed pa ni drang bden gyi rtsom pa por rag lus gshis/ ji ltar na'ang nga tshor g.yo 'khyog med pa'i smyug thogs pa dgos mkho ha cang che/skabs 'dir yang / na gathongan rtsom pa po bya dor phun phogs dbang phyug gam gangs khyodan lags kyi bsam blo'i thir rtse las 'khyugs pa'i brtsams chodas cadags bsgrigs/ 〈〈skyag bro ba'i 'jig rten 〉〉zhes pa 'di ni khong gis rang mi rigs dang / rgyal khabo/ rig gzhung bcas la gnang ba'i rma med kyi legs skyes shig yin pa kun kyi yid ngor gsal bar yod/ khong gi brtsams chos 'di'i nang sku la rgyun snyan ngag dang / deng rabs snyan ngag lhag sna ma bcas tshan pa gsum du dbye 'dug pa ma zad/ de dag kyang rdo chag btsan sgrig ltar gyi 'bar 'bur dang / shwa cadad kyi lam bu bzhin shar shur ma yin la/ yang na mi rabs kha shas kyi rjes su thod ba 'o/na srid pa'i 10da rgal gyi snyan ngag de 'dra'ang ma yin par/ ce ma pyowa zhig gis rab rib kyi spyi tshogs 'og myangs ba'i sems tshor skyar mo dang / rang mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse sems rnal ma/ da dung gzhan ༄/gang ltar rtsom rig dang dus rabs kyi dalha sa mkho bzhin rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan ras su bkra la/ mngar skyar gyi lnge ba zab cing / mar rtsam gyi dri ngad 'thul ler 'phyur ba 'di ni/ khong gis rang nyid kyi bla srog gi me lce gangs can pa'i las dbang ched du sbar te 'jig rten na ches tha ma'i yang thar 'du shes pa'i khrims mun du bgrang bya lnga bzhugs pa'i bsam blo'i skyod bsun dang / de bzhin 97na skusnangs kyi spyi cesags rgyus 'o1na/ lhag par du mi gshis khral khrul la yid mug 11gas bstan bya du ma bathe sbyang byas pa'i bsam pa'i cadan rdzas shig yin zhing / 'o/ sngo ji snyed cig nang kher 'dug dang / las chodar skabs 'bri ce ma byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi mu tig dog po 'di ko/ gzhis byes gnyis shar dbyangs gsal so bzhir rin thang 8

gleng brdzod/med la/ stsodar snu/sa rgyal thabs zin cing shin tu nyag phra ba'i dus rabs 'dir/ rang nyid kyi snying dbus nas gces pa'i gna' ba'i mi rigs shig dang / rgyal khab cig la dung ba'i tshe sku ga gi dbyangs rta yin la/ nam yang 'dzad mtha' med pa'i lhasnen me zhig kyang yin/snyan ngag ni g.yul sa yi thod masnu na dang / 'grul bzhud kyi lam sne yin/snyan ngag ni brtse sems kyi mig chu dang / mngar skyar gyi ro bcud yin/ snyan ngag la snying rje med cing / snyan ngag la sdang semasi kyang med/ gang ltar snyan ngag ni dus rabs dang mi rigs shig gi tshab mtshon rdo ring yin//rda sa nas dbus phrug tshe ring gis/ 2006 /1 /20 nyin/9

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/sgyur rtsi dang 'dres pa'i 'go brjod gzhan zhigar༅༅/ /pha sa dgra lag tu shor ba'i mtshan mo de nas bzung gangs ri'i da /ra mdangs med la gangs chab kyi bzhur sgra sim pas bo nga ma lha yang zhen pa'i 'jig rten gyi gru zur de'i mtha' sner mi dmar po'i dpung sdes khengs shing / byis pa'i ngu skad dang a ma'i 'bod sgra/ gzhon nu'i brtse 'dang gi gdung 'bod sogs yod tshad btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mche sder rnon po'i so khar drangs/a a/ khrag dron gyi kha rlangs dang mi ro'i bang rim gyi khong gseng du/ri spyang gi 'dur rgyugs dang srin bya'i.ag skad gyi rol dbyangs skya mos po ta la'i dril skad yang mog por byas stabs/ go la'i rgyab rol na rang dbang gi bag la nyal ba'i lha dbang rgya sbyin yang / mi rigs de'i skyo gar gyi dus rabs thod rgal der dungs snang dang rigs zhen gyis skyom pa'i bzhin ras sprin nag gis 'khrigs shing / tsho ra shugs drag wa'i mya ngan dang mchi ma'i bzhur rgyun ring mo / bo la zlum po'i gting rum du 'phyur te 'jig rten gsar pa zhig gam rnam shes gasku na 'o/ zhig gi sa tho/na 'debs par brel/skabs du mar bdag gis dathodang mtha'i mtshams sprin la cer nas gcadang 'khyod kyi mig chu grangs med cig gyer snu/nga ba ni/ bdag gi nye 'kho ra na gnas pa'i na zla tsho'i mig chu bzhin bzhur sla la chad kyang sla ba'i brtse gdung gi mig chu rdog po de ma yin la/ yang na yod tshad rang nyid la 'dod pa'i spyo ham gyi zog rdzu'i mig chu ni de bas kyang ga la yin/ de ni bdag la mchongan na ches gsang bar gyur pa'i gzugs med kyi sdug bsngal zhig yin pas/ phal cher hi ma la ya'i ri rtser kha ba nag po chags yod pa ltar kho bo'i slo snying gi hrag dbar du'ang rdul phran gyi 10

skyur rtsi dang 'dres pa'i 'gyo brdzod gzhan lhagagad snyigs shig 'thor sku da par sems/ma gzhi sprin dmar ni 'byung bzhi'i rten 'brel las 'asgyu sa pa'i kha dodag cig yin yang srid mod/ kho bo'i bsam byar de ni 'di 'dra'i stabs bde mor 'grel bshad casas pa'i shes bya'i mtshan gzhi zhig ma yin par mi rigs shig gi dus rabs gcig gi yod tshad 'thor zhig tu song ba'i skyo gar gyi dran rtags shig la ngos len bzhu bzhin sku da/gang ltar sbra nag gi gtam rgyud la rtsodags tshig btab pa'i mtshan ljo ngas ring mo der/ mtho sgang gi skar phreng grangs med cig gi tshe srog gi mchod me bzhur sku da la rtsodags mtha' med pa'i mun pa mthug lnga de'i bla gab tu/ cadad snang phra mo zhig gi skya thig la 17gas nas btsan cadal gyi rkang lam 'grim pa'i nga chog sngo na pa'i rgya rnyi las thar ba'i ri dwags rmas ma bzhin/ zug gzer dang mnar gcod la ji mi snyam par kha dodag med pa'i 'khyam po'i 'chod lam der bsnyegs/de bas mi 'o/ bcu phrag du mar bran gasku ga gi las dbang 'khur ba'i nga chortas /sos dal bag phebs kyi rmi lam ljang khu zhig sngas su lha ma pa dang re sgug stong phrag gi smon pa mkha' la gyer rung / nyi zla'i shul rjes kyis dbul ba'i bdagadang 'brong gi pha sar/ sngar bzhin kla klo'i gdug rtsub kyi khrag dri ma yal la rab rib sab sib kyi lo zla'i lteb khug nang sdug bsngal gyi mig chu mtsho ltar brdol ba dang / smre ngag dang cad ro/da rlung bzhin grags rkyen bas mtha'i skyod gdung gis mnar ba'i bdag gi sems dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nam zlar ha cang 'tshub/mtshams de nas bzung / bdag gis snyan ngag gi rgyal khams rgyang nas bstodar te dpa' wa'i rjes shul gyi khrag thigs 'cho la bar chas la/ sgyu rtsal gyi bya lam thol gyis gshags nas nyi zla'i 'od snang dang skar tshogs kyi 'dzumag dang 'tshol bzhin yodad/ ji srid smag rum gyi sgrib gasku ga ma zhig bar du/spyi 'o/ 2007/2/8 nyin rtsom pa pos/11
skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/ngas gnas lugs kyis lha ngas ba'i 'jig rten 'dir/ji ltar byas nas zhen chags byed dbo sa sam/da wa2 lta gangs smyon/

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/sna tshogs sems kyi zug rnga/ spe༄dri med stu gsar sprin gyi khri 'phang na 'gyings pa'i//tshangs pa'i slo la co 'dri dgra bcom gyi rgyal po//las dang rgyu 'bras khas len byed mus shig yin rung //kho cad sems nad mal las thar dus shig mi 'dug/ zuya gi'i dkon mchog gsum la dad mchod kyi bkur dang //ma gi'i ngan slong dag la sbyin pa rang stsal rung //'asnur gnas ngal bas lus po'i zungs bcud kun nyams pa'i//rgyu 'bras cha mi lha mas pa'i las dbang de gang yin//mthong ba don yod byams ldan pha ma yi bslab bya//ma nyan khe/nga nas thertel ba'i pra tshag la 'bad pas//pho rgod dar ma'i la rgya rgas 'khar dang 'grogs dgos//'khor ba'i rnam smin min pa'i gtan tshigs der sus 'grel//dmar nag rgya 'dre mthu mo'i dug sprul gyi lce zhags//thabs 'phrul rigs pa'i ral gris dum bu ru bcad kyang //nang gi phyogs 'then 'dre sgod thal rdul du bslog pa'i//drag sngags hūṃ phaḍa sgrog pa'i drang srong de su yin//— 2 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/smag nag mun pa zab pa'i gra bzhi yi batho na du//sdug bsngal 'o dod drag po brag cha la 'khor yang //lus sems dod ngo ra gyur ba'i rtsam zan gyi sngo da mis//dga' spro'i skor bro lding ba'i ltas ngan der ltos dang //lto gos don du gnyer ba'i grwa btsun gyi dpung dang //dam chodas chodar la brje ba'i dge bshes la gzhigs tshe//rnag khrag zas su 'gams pa'i yi dgas kyi bo/nga khyer//da dung mi 'ong zer ba'i nges pa ni mi 'dug/a phas gzhang khang nang du mdzes ma la 'thams shing //a mas sbag khang nang du khyim chas kyang 'cho nga gis//'tsho ba'i 'go 'don med pa'i dwa phrug gi las dbang //de ring bod la byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi gleng gzhi//ce ma gyi mdung rtse 'das pa'i mi drag la sdigs shing //don gyi rgyab ljongs nang khul 'phung dkrug gi gzhi ma//dkar nag sku/ga 'grel khram pas dus rabs la dbang bsgyur//de ring phyi rol yul gyi tshur snang gi lan cha//chung nas 'dris pa'i bo gas dag lta grub la 'gal zhing //mdza' bas bskyangs pa'i bo gas mo dngul rjes su snyeg skabs//tshe gcig re bas gzhol ba'i 'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba//'ja' tshon gos su re ba'i rmi lam las ma 'das//da 3 da

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/dri med chos char gyis brlan bsil ldan gyi ljongs su//snga na dam mkhas pa'i rjes shul mig lam du bkrag kyang //ma rig ling to/ga gis bsgribs snyigs dus kyi rje dngo na//gangs ri'i kha dog de dang mtshungs dpe zhig e 'dug/rta dmag khri yis gnam sa'i pha mtha' la babo(da cing //dam chodas cad mas gangs dkar lha chodags la tshim ster//mnga' thang gra rgyas rnam sras bang malhudud la 'khu ba//da lta deb ther zad do'i gzugs brnyan las gzhan ci//phyi yi dgra bor sdang mig bgrad pa yang mi baphra da//nang gi spun zlar spu gri'i ya lad kyis sdang sdigs//dgra gnyen mgo ldog a ma 'drer mthong gi bu rul//sprel srin gdung rabs 'dzin pa'i rgyu rkyen du grub bam//skyes ma thag pa'i phrug gu ce ma rdzas la sred cing //lo drug gson pa'i byis pa 'dod gtam la 'dun pa//pha yis bu mor spyod pa'i dus rabs kyi ltas ngan//ma lus gangs ri'i ljongs su da thengs la mthong byung //brtse bas bskyangs pa'i bu sdug bathe na khang du gyar zhing //'bad pas bsags pa'i rgyu cadar gzhung khral gyis bathodam pa /dka' sdug 'o/ zlas mi tshe mig chu dang bsres pa'i//bdag gi yab yum gnyis kyi rnam thar la gzigs 1rigs//— 4 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rton/dga' ba brgya ldan mes 1rware shul bzhag gi zhing khams//dbang med srin wa dmar shā sa khur mid du btang bas//bkres stodam mu ges mnar ba'i shul lus kyi mabo na sngo ra//sku/ga gi ka ba 〈mil mkhas lha chen khyed gar bzhugs//gon lha na phal cher snum zad mar me bzhin lha ngas shing //na gzhon rnams ni dus rabs zing 'tshub la mgo 'khor//byis pa chung ngus dmar po'i lta spyod la sbyong dus//bod ljongs rang btsan nyin mor re snyeg gcig 'dug gam//masprodang tshad lad mo byed pa deng rabs kyi 'khrul snang //yod tshad dngul gyis kha bsgyar mi yul gyi ltad mo//nyam chung skye bor bkod pa'o las dbang gi skyo bsun//nyin dang mtshan mo kun tu bsangs dus ni mi 'dug/gasku na pa'i mi la rang dbang gu yangs kyis sko ngas shing //'das pa'i dpa' thodar mya ngan gus 'dud kyis dbul ba//'chi kha'i skye bor sman gyi sbyin pa de dkon rung //shi ma gasku na du 'chos dbo sa mi tshe yi khral las//gdug rtsub spyang kir do ba'i dpon ngan gyi rigs dang //gasku sgyu'i las la byang pa chodas gzugs kyi 'dus mang //yi dgas 'dra ba'i mo/ dman mi yul gyi bran gasku ga/mthong ba'i mod la 'tsho ba'i 'dun zhen yang brlags song / /da 5 da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/srin 'bu 'dra ba'i mi ser mun klong du 'phyan zhing //lta grub med pa'i mi ngan khram rgan gyi rjes 'brang //le lo'i 'dam du 'bying pa gangs can gyi gzhon rabs//de gsum 'jo mas pas sku nga btsan rnam shes kyang yer sku nga //lhan skyes rang lugs 'chol ba'i mi dmangs kyi dpung dang //stsodangs pa dud 'gro'i khyu gnyis dbang med du mtshungs na//chab srid dug sdong las skyes dmangs gtso yi me tog/bslu med mchog gsum dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas du 'gro'am//dge 'dun sde pa'i tshul khrims 'dam rdzab las ngan zhing / /shes ldan mi sna'i 'dod rngams me ri la 'gran pa//mi sems g.yo yis gang ba'i ljan ljin gyi khor yug/zhi bde'i 'od snang spro ba'i bsti gnas su 'gyur ram//'on kyang bden bzhi'i chos kyi zag med kyi bdud rtsi//cung zad btungs par sems pa'i dbugs dbyung zhig phyung yang / /gnas lugs gdodan gyis bslus pa'i na gachodan gyi dpung zhig/skyabs med mgon med lus pa'i rkyen snang der mug byung //kun rtog sems sngo ra 'char ba'i sdug yus kyi snying gtam//dngas ba'i gshis lugs btus pa'i chu phran la gyer skabs//smra ba'i sko chen dben pa'i gser mig gi khyu des//gdung sems rlabs dkar galta ra ba'i ya mtshan zhig mchodang byung //da 6 da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/da ni 'jig rten 'di na snying po ni mi 'dug/ 'tsho ba'i bslu brid 'di la bcos thabs kyang mi 'dug/bcos ma'i 'dzum mdangs mkho ba'i de ring gi spyi tshogs//bsam bzhin bsam na rjesan paci( 'du khang las ma 'das//des na dbul wa'i mi la nyin mtshan du dgongs par//brel dang rtsol ba'i dal ba cung zad tsam stongs pa'i//dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i shes rab kyi lha zhig/bzhugs na de ring bdag la bden rgyab ci ga gachodangs dang //

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ 'char ka/rgongs lnga'i nyi nub kyi 'char ka/mtshams sprin sil cho ma la bo/la bas//dmar sha'i rang mdangs kyis btab pa'i//byad bzhin ku mud de dran byung //phu yi spang rgyan gyi me tog/'dzum rlabs chil chil du bzhad rung //sems sku nga skal bzang gi me lta ga/nam zla'i zad sar yang mi lha ba//reg 'jam dpyid rlung dang lhan du//zhi bsil sbrang char zhig phab kyang //ljang bu'i sngo sing gis dben pa'i//mya ngam bye thang de skyo ba//bsung zhim me tog gi do rar//ljang khra'i phye leb kyis lding yang //g.yu sbrang gshog glu zhig med pa'i//rdzing bu'i pad+ma nga skyo ba//da 8 da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/dung zla kher 'gros kyi slong nas//skar mda'i me stag de 'tshub skabs//sku ma nyi'i khrodag thag gis bcings pa'i//sems pa'i rta rgod de shor song //sham chu'i bab rgyun gyi 'gram par//྅geng 'dang nam mkha' la cer tshe//rlabs kyi zegs ma yi rtse nas//chu skyar gad mo rang shor song // g.yu lo'i zhe'u sing gi tshal na//'bu gog mnyam 'dug la rol dus//mdza' brtse'i zhabs bsna/da kyis 'tshengs pa'i /spyi gling kher snang gis gzir 'dug/bdud rtsi a rag gi mchod ka/lha yi rdzing rlabs bzhin skyom yang //snying bsil 'dod mal sman pa//'o chang mngar mo de kho na//dri med a sngon gyi dbyings su//chu khur 'dab tshar de g.yo skabs//srab dkar smad gasku ga gi 'gab nas//'jam sha'i mjal kha de dran byung //da 9 da

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chedzes 3tshegs bsgrigs/zab gsang dam chodas kyi gsung dbyangs//mtshan ldan bla ma des lha ga rung // rab snyan snying gtam gyi rgyud skud//dkrol ba'i lha mo de su yin//li khri'i gur khyim gyi spyodang nas//rab smin shing tog de mngon skabs//sbrang rtsi'i bro bcud las lhag pa'i//byu ru'i mchu 'dab de dran byung //rgya tshogs stong 'dus kyi khrom rar//mdzes ma'i 'dzum sgeg de bskyed rung //bcu drug na tshod kyis spud pa'i//lang tsho'i gur kum de khyed rang //mtsho gling 'dab cha gas kyi bsti sar//skyar skyur gdangs snyan de 'kho la skabs//rbertso ba lhad med kyi mgur dbyangs//gyer ba'i mkha' 'gro khyed bde'am//bsangs med snying chung gi lu gu'i//'ba' 'ba'i skyo/ gzhas gcig blangs par//gting zab byams gdung gis bzi ba'i//rdzi bo lhas 'dabs su 'khor dang //— 10 —

skyug rgyo ba'i 'dzog rten/smyon pa snang ba skyid pa'i mgur/gzhon dus dga' ba'i brtse grogs ngas ma btsal//rgas tshe mkho ba'i rgyu sna ra ngar ma bdodag/spyon pa'i mi tshe 'khos med sprang po bzhin//rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //bshes gnyen dam par bsnyen bkur ngas ma bgyis//mdza' bshes phru ba mar mthun lam ngas ma bskyangs//spyodan pa'i mi tshe rang snang gu yangs ngang //rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //btson khang 'go 'khrid bka' khrims ngas ma rtsis//bce na pa dmangs la bab bstun ngas ma rtsad//khyodan pa'i mi tshe a 'thas ya med ngang //rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //macadan wa'i mi la sprel 'dzum ngas ma bstan//nyam chung skye bor khro gnyer ngas ma bsdus//khyodan pa'i mi tshe btang snyodams lam thig steng //rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //da 11 da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ 'jig rten lugs mthun khyim thab ngas ma 'dzin//lha choges dam pa'i 'dul khrims ngas ma bsrungs//spyodan pa'i mi tshe skya min ser min khoged//rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //rab byung btsun pa rnams dang nga ma mthun//phal pa 'jig rten mi dang nga ma 'dris//spyon pa'i mi tshe pho rog dkar po bzhin//rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //brtse ldan pha ma'i byams drin ngas ma gamo la//gnyen bshes nye 'dur phan lan ngas ma 'asnga gas//smyon pa'i mi tshe gtad med dgu rul ngang //rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //sangs rgyas bstan par zhabs do/ga ngas ma zhus//mi 'bor 'phel rgyas bya gzhag ngas ma bskrun//smyon pa'i mi tshe go rim chal chol ngang //rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //chodas nyid mthar thug zab gnas ngas ma stodags//brtse gdung zab mo'i rin thang ngas ma shes//smyon pa'i mi tshe sbi rag bzi kha'i khrod//rdzogs pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang /— 12 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/dbyin ji'i bu mo'i mo dad nga la med//rgya gar mdzes ma'i rnam par nga ma 'khrul//spyodan pa'i mi tshe gangs dkar lha mo dang // cadags pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //bcu drug na tshod nges 'byung rlung gis bdas//nyi shu'i lang tsho mun nag btson du bskyal//smyon pa'i mi tshe skyid med sdug gi cadag/sgyu gas pa'i snang ba de yi skyid pa ang //

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ ma bcos sems kyi thugs mgur /glu a la tha la tha la red//tha la mo glu yi len lugs red//thengs gsum ngag gi 'gug lugs red//srid pa'i glu yi rang lugs red//sa de yi sa ngo shes mi shes//sa de yi sa ngo mi shes na//gnas 'phags yul rda ram sa la red//deng 7rgyal ba'i bzhugs sgar pho brang red / /mi nga 'dra nga sngor mi shes na/ /pho rgod po gangs ri'i smyon pa yin/gtam 'di gtam cad mi shes na //ma bathodas sems kyi mgur glu red//rdza gseb kyi sha ba yu mo de//khyo shug gi las dbang rdzogs le min//bu skyes kyi gdung ba gzir po des//bag chags kyi na bun 'thibs pa'i rtags/ /— 14

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/byang thang gi kha dkar rkyang rgod de//bang rtsal gyi rtsal dgu sngo gas le min//rkyang dbu 'phang dgung la btegs pa de//ljid galha na gyi ro/sa shig ma bkal rtags//chol gsum gyi bod mi rkyal stodang tsho//rnam rig la grung sha dod le min//tshe gang phra gasku sgyar sbyang sbyang nas//mi sems la wa rgoshis 'bo/sa pa'i rtags//stag shar pa'i dbo da sgra thags se thag/dman bu mo'i dathodad 'dzum shigs se shig/gachodan dar ma'i snang ba macad masprod de//lto bo sa kyi gnya' shing ma phab rtags// —mchotsho mtha' yi ngang pa kher 'acadas de//'alha da chags la zhen 'o/ga skyes le min//dungs dungs kyi nam zla skyel ba de// khyod bral gyi dran snang lci ba'i rtags//yul gyar gyi bod rigs spun zla rnams// gnas a ri'i phyogs su 'bad pas bros//ḍo lar la dang dod langs le min//'jig rten 'di dngul gyis bskrun pa'i rtags// — 15 —

gangs nyunye sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/mdod med kyi bce na rgan gangs khyodan nga //rgya gar du sems shugs chag le min//ga1—ga ga11ba la gzigs gaskusgol che ba yi//btsan byol gyi gzhung 'dir dgod re bro//mtho bka' spyi'i sku ngo tshon po rnams//lam dbu mar bden zhen zab le min//mgon 7rgyal bar dbu skor gtong ba'i slad//dus nam bar spel lad mjug ma ring //gos ngur smrig gyon pa'i a chos tsho//chothos 'dul ba'i gnad /ra ma gzab par//phral sla dzadas khetho nar g.yam rgyugs nas//sems gnyug ma'i rgyal thabs ma 'dzin skyod//mtshan byin rlabs grags can gdan sa yi//gong dge bshes stag seng kha sprod dag/chodas 'asnu nga gi mdzad 'phrin rgyas dus des//dus snyigs dus zin pa'i nges shes rnyed / /khong byang chub sems pa'i sprul pa dngos//rje 7rgyal dbang tā la'i bla ma la//lam log ltas skur ba 'debs pa po// col chung gi gang zag ya ma brla//— 16 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/yongs gangs ri'i khrod kyi sprul sku yi//phreng rim gyi dang por bsku med gcig/tse/ rgyan ya phrin las the rje la//mi bsrun skye bo yi sdang zug drag/cadad snu sa ldan rgyal ba'i zhing khams la//bdud nag po'i 'dre lag skyong mkhas pa'i//rgya dmar po gung khran ring lugs la//dus ji srid dgra bo'i snying 'dzin gyis//chod rig pa bkra ba'i nya ma rnams//rang pha skad gces 'dzin mi byed par//gling phyi mi'i dbyin skad hal hol la//shi sbar 'thams byed pa'i 〈snal ngan dar//las sku nam gnam the mabo lhang gi/mang zhing 'thodag sku sa dal mi ser rnams//gasku lhad med mes wa'i gshis lugs kun//dus da mtshams than skam rdzing bu 'dra//lugs chodas srid nyi zla kha lho ra gyi//mtshan grags ldan dga' ldan pho brang de//rdza dum bur chag pa'i rmi lam bzhin//lam de 'drar gyar 'gro su la sems//da 17 da rī

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/phyi dgra cadar sdang mig mi nus par//nang spun zlar dgra sta 'phyar dpa' ba//las byas pa dran nam cadad rigs snu //a sdug gi las thabs de la lto sa//chodas zab mo nang bstan gzhung lugs de//'phral skyen pa'i tshan rig dper bkab nas//tshe 'di phyi'i 'dun ma chur bskyur ba'i//snyigs dus kyi sems can ngu re bro//gces cadas kyi rgyal khab dgra cadar cadar//bkur cadas pa'i dpa' bo'i tshe sku ga brlags//khrag ro/na mo'i kha rlangs ma yal rung //snying med kyi bod mis glu gar byed// mkha' dbyings su bya rgod gshog 'gyur ngom//rdza thang na ri spyang ngud mo sgrog/pha yul du mi mo sa khengs na yang //gzhan yul du chol kha'i phyogs 'then rgod//yin mdodag mdodag byed pa'i grwa btsun 'ga'//sbedam grub pa nyams len mi byed par//zhe gnag pa'i srid don bya byed la//lam dga' bas cartos pa'i ngang tshul mtshar//— 18 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/yangs 'dzam gling sa yi bo la 'dir//che chung gi rgyal khab 'dra 'dra'i kho da// cadad gdodang dmar mi las spra 'chal gcig/gnas gang du med pa kho thag red//rgyang ring gi 'khor ba'i gru zur na/ /khrims med kyi mi yi 'dus sde zhig/dmangs gce dang rang dbang khar 'khyer nas//dkar nag la mthod lde ga rtsodam gzhin gda'//lar da dung rda sa'i 'du tshogs dbus//mabo klad zho skam pa'i skra ring 'ga'// bod spyi mi'i rkang 'dren yad yud ngang //dman dbyin mo'i 'a'o/ngas mgor lce ldag byed//las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ma nges shing //skyabs 'bo/ yi bslab byar ma gzab pa//mi skra ser mig ljang khyi rigs de//snga da bstan pa galta ra ba'i 'byung bya yin//gangs seng gi rmi lam 'khrugs dus dang //gangs ljongs kyi rlung rta rgud dus su//pha mes kyi thod rus gtor phod pa'i//snying med kyi gzhon nu'i dpung zhig 'dug/da 19da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/la la zhig dbu ma'i lam la snungs//re 'ga' zhig bden pa'i u tshugs gdod//mang dze zhig rang btsan gtsang mar ce da//mtha' mjug tu bod de rgya la sprad//61 rgyus kyi chu maboto de nas skam//rgyal rabs kyi mkhar mang de nas zhig/mi rabs kyi margyud de nas stong //dus rabs kyi skyob gar de nas zin//tshe 〉ten ma'i las skal lci bas gcig/yul gangs can sa bcud nyams pas gnyis//11da maboste nag ba11da nams sngo gas pa gsum//rgya dmar po dar ba'i gasku sa char yin//rang mi la la rgya dben pas gcig/rang rgyal la dga' dungs med pa gnyis//rang rig la brtson sbyangs bral ba gsum//mi rigs gcig brlag pa'i mngon rtags red//dus ding sang gangs ri'i rgyal khams su//bla rdzun dang grwa log gi bstan pa dar//ngo tsha dang khrel yod dug chur 'dzin//kha bde dang khram rgan spyi ngo ra bkur//—20—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rton/sdar ma dang blun snga sa dpa' gtam lha ga/mkhas pa dang gzhung bzang srang mdodar bskyur//las 'bras dang bden pa khyi lud rtsis//chodas sku ga dang lam 'o/ga yid dam byed//kye gzigs dang pha rgan mi la rje//snyan gson dang rdo rje 'chang ba dngos//mig mchi ma 'khrug pa'i gdung 'alha da de//nga gangs ri'i spyodan pa'i skyod mgur yin//

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/zla ba'i snyan ngag rgyu skar bye ba yis bskor ba'i//lhang 'tsher zla ba de rig dus//stag shar grangs med kyis grung pa'i//mdzes ldan lha mo khyed dran byung //mtshan mo'i zla cardod kyi codig tu//gcig pur 'cham 'cham la chas dus//na zla'i rogs tshogs ya khyed dang // glu len gar khrab de dran byung //sprin pa thar jo ra gyi gseb nas//zla ba'i 'od snang de 'phros skabs// mi tshogs 'du long gi dbus kyi//zur mig g.yon po de dran byung //tshes chen bakhyod lnga yi zla ba//shar ri'i phrag pa nas 'dzum dus//'bri mo'i bachod dbyangs la bkug pa'i//mdza' gzhas snyan mo/ de dran byung //— 22

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/zla ba sgor sgor gyi dkyil du//ri bong gzugs brnyan de snang skabs//mdzes ma'i brang gzhung na 'bur ba'i//'o 'dzin mar gsar de dran byung //sprin dkar bang rim gyi mgul bar//tshe ris lding skor rang byed dus//lcang gling gru bzhi yi nang gi//ldem pa'i byad gzugs de dran byung //gangs ri dkar gtsang gi ngo gas su //dung zla'i cadad dkar de 'khyil skabs// shel gyi 'o/ brang nang 'gyings pa'i//gangs dkar sras mo khyed dran byung //dgu tshigs the shal gyi dbus su//bsil sbyin bdag snu/ de 'tshurme dus//'gran med dre bas sems kyis phyug pa'i//mdzangs ldan smin legs khyed dran byung //ston rlung sil sil dang lhan du//zla ze ra lam lam du 'tsher dus//snying gtam bdud rtsi yi smra sgo'i//'byed btsums mchu 'dab de dran byung //— 23 —

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/lha na lnga'i zla bkrag gi cadag tu//khrung khrung lto mtha' ru 'phu ra skabs//sa mtho'i ri grong du lus pa'i//gzhung bzang na chung khyed dran byung //—24ba

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/nem gur gyi lha ga thagargyal ba gshegs pa'i mtha' khab cig tu 'bo ba'i 'dren chen su yis gnang //btsan sngo dre la ba'i yul khams shig gi 'bangs mi'i bde sdug su la zhu//bla mas bskyur ba'i dge btsun zhig gi thar pa'i lam lha na su la 'dri//dge bshes dbul ba'i rig stegs shig tu rigs pa'i gad rgyangs su la sprodag/rkang drug med pa'i me tog cig gi ze'u 'bru'i snying gtam su la smra//'jol mo 'phur ba'i lcang gling zhig gi bsil ba'i gdugs gur su la dbab//g.yang lug med pa'i spang rtswa cig gi tshe sku ga legs skyes su la 'bul//nyi zer bzhud pa'i mtshan smag cig gi pad+ma'i kher bsun su yis dodags//dgun gzhung yal ba'i nam zla 'di ru dpyid dpal ro/da rlabs su la mkho //'dab chags/ stongs ba'i ljon tshal 'di ru khu byug dbyangs snyan su la gyer//ljang gzhon med pa'i ri thang 'di ru sbrang char sil ma su la 'jo//tsha gdung med pa'i yul ljongs 'di ru dpyid rlung ser bu su la ldang //rdza lung med pa'i 'brong rgod dag gi rngams brjid rwa rtsed su la ngom//byang thang med pa'i 'o/ rkyang zhig gi sug bzhi'i mchodangs 'thodas gang du rtsen//nags sngo nga med pa'i rgya stag cig gi 'dzum drug tsham rngam su la zher//gangs ri med pa'i seng phrug cig gi g.yu yi rdzubs ral gang du 'phyar//'gyur khug dben pa'i ri zhol 'di na rdzi bo'i gling bu su la 'bud//gasku na shugs nyams pa'i lung bo ga 'di na chu phran glu dbyangs su la len//rba rlabs 'jags pa'i gram thang 'di na ngang pa kher 'dug su la rig/— 25—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/zla 'od mog pa'i sa srod 'di na snyan ngag mkhan po su la 'bod//stag shar med pa'i 'du tshogs 'di ru mdzes ma'i ldem bskyod su la 'degs//rol dbyangs med pa'i mal gur 'di ru gzhon dar 'dod pa ga la rdzogs//rgas po med pa'i spyi gling 'di ru rgan mos 'cham seng ga la bskyar//lo lon med pa'i dman shar khrod du rgas po'i kha pho ga la brjodo//che tshugs can gyi bshes gnyen zhig la bsti stangs bku ra bachod su yis lcigs//rig pa dmun pa'i mgo stodang zhig la shes rab lha mos ga la gzigs//'chod gnas ngal ba'i rul nyag cig gis lus wa'i zungs bcud ga la gsos//snang g.yel bral ba'i gru 'o/gas shig tu bu chodab sems pa ga la rnal//lha ra mo bsri ba'i zhabs rim zhig gis nad pa'i rims nad ga la chodag/dmar bsur med pa'i zlog bathodas shig gis ngo na rgan lha srung ga la mgu//bsang dud med pa'i stsogen lam zhig gis gzhis bdag phyal ba ga la rgyag/ltag lha med pa'i las khungs shig tu dasngo na wa'i gces phrug ga la thar//chu gas ris mod pa'i glang rgan min na blun po'i go sar ga la lhags// ha shang bdud wa'i skye srid min na 'dre srin chodags kyis ga la bkur//'khyodag bachadad gtam gyi dug mda' min na rma byas cad gur ga la dbab//byur bsdud ltas kyi g.yang bkug min na mtshan mo'i bya yis ga la blags//sbi rag med pa'i skyar rtsi zhig gis snyan ngag pa la sems gasku bral//chodas bshad med pa'i nyams len zhig gis a ri'i ho lar ga la thems//ya yud med pa'i mtsher gachodan zhig gis khram pa'i mig zung ga la mchodad//lhang 'tsher med pa'i gangs ri zhig gis bsil ldan ljo ngas ka ga la mchodan//dri zhim sman rtsu'i yo re med na mtho sgang rtswa thang ga la slobs//sbra gur dbul ba'i spang gshongs shig tu 'bri mo'i bzho dbyangs su la bkug/snye rlabs med pa'i gshin sa de ru zhing grong bu mo ga la 'dzum//—26 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/dam tshig gas pa'i chodab bu zhig la gsang sngags lha ma pa ga la ༄stal//slob sdom med pa'i gsog gsob cig la 'dul ba'i lam khrid su yis mdzad/ /gtad so med pa'i lta grub cig la rtsod ngag rol mo su yis 'grol//don po sdog pa'i bstan bcos shig la gzur gnas mkhan po su yis dpyod//la rgya lnga ra ba'i 'dzum thodags shig la bo sa kyi sna ga kha ga la gleng //dung tshor med pa'i mdza' gcugs shig la brtse chang mngar mo su yis ldug/spro snang yal ba'i 'tsho sde da cig gi sems gzhas phra mo su/ la bskul// rang dbang brlags pa'i mi rigs shig gi khrag gi 'o/ rgyus su la 'asnga mas//

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ gnam sa'i mtha' yi ngu rgyangs/mdo la dar gyi ri rtse'i mgul bar//phying dkar lwa ba'i 'dab tshar g.yos tshe//ke la sha ri'i mu khyud sbrel ba'i//mtho sgang bod kyi ri ljongs dran byung//lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi rtse mor//chu skyar ma bu lding skor rtsen dus//ngang ngur pho mo rtsed dga' spro ba'i//yar klungs gtsang po'i dba' rlabs dran byung //lhan snyug nags kyi ljosten pa'i tshal du//no༅ zurag larabag yangs ra skyas g.yang rtsal skrun skabs//lha shing shug pas nam mkha' sgrib pa'i//bsam yas mchims phu'i dben gnas dran byung //spu med ma he 'o zor bkug nas//'o ma'i rgya mtsho dgung la bsrubs kyang //bcud ldan mar gyi bro kha med dus//'bri mar ser sha'i 'gram chu ldang byung //—28 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/dkyil 'kho ra tsha ba'i gyu kha 'di ru//bying rmugs rlung gis 'byung bzhi gtsos skabs//dus bzhi'i nam zla'i 'gyur khug gsal ba'i//bsil ldan ljo ngas kyi dus tshigs dran byung //dri ngan 'dam gyi chu rul zhig gis//sngon med pho ba'i god ka bslong skabs//lus zungs gasku ba'i sman gyi dngas ma//bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs gangs chab dran byung //ma macadang grags pa'i 'phags pa'i yul gyi//mi sdug 'tsho ba'i las rim khrod du//'bras dang lda li'i ༷skyur kha myong tshe//sha mar thud kyi bro bcud dran byung //rda ram sa la'i ri sdings de nas//'dre 'bod khu ta'i ag skad thos skabs//'dab ldan ljon pa'i rgyan char snyems pa'i//yar klungs 'jol mo'i gsungs snyan dran byung //rgya gar rgyal sa'i gru zur zhig nas//ye shu'i dbo na pa'i sil snyan 'khotshel skabs//chodas 'kho ra dpal gyi mkha' na grags pa'i//gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i dril skad dran byung //— 29—

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos 3tshegs bsgrogs/man ju ḍi li'i ༷srang lam kun tu//rgya gar sprang po lto gas grir 'chi skabs//ra bzi'i rnam thar skad sangs masngo ba'i//bar skor nang gi sprang tshogs dran byung //snum tshon med pa'i ri thang gcig tu//mdog ngan khyi spung ngu zug gyer skabs//tsham rngam skad kyis dgra snying bkad pa'i//seng ge'i yang tsha bod khyi dran byung //ngo mtshar go la'i 'gran stegs rtse mor//rgya gar bu morto mdzangs mar bdam skabs//grags snyan nam mkhaci) mtha' na grags paci)//zla ba lha la ma'i gtam rgyud dran byung //byin rlabs brgya ldan rdo rje gdan gyi//gnam zug mchod rten mig la rig dus//mabo med zhabs kyi mya ngan lci ba'i//brag sgo /lha'i mchod rten dran byung //brjid chags rgyal ba'i bzhugs sgar gling du//chu gas mtha'i skye rgu phyag skedar bgyid skabs//ma ṇi'i gdangs dbyangs kho ga na mid pa'i//gtsug lag khang gi mdun thang dran byung //— 30—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rton/ma hā lhan dhi'i ༷dran gso khang du//rjes dran me thodag char du snyil skabs//dungs pa'i bsur zhig bdug dbang bral ba'i//dpa' bo'i dur sa lha ldan dran byung //rgyus med mi yi yul gru 'di na//pha yul med pa'i dwa phrug du mas//skyod ba'i mchi ma brang khar snyil dus//gangs dkar skyed ma'i 'dzum mdangs dran byung //rga ba'i khur gyis lus sems rgud pa'i//skra dkar rgan pos rang btsan khyodad skabs//khri sku nga dmag gis 'dzam gling 'dar ba'i//skal bzang dus kyi rmi lam dran byung //nyi 'od med pa'i nam zla'i zur nas//dmar nag sprin gyi rbab sngo 'gril skabs//zungs khrag dmar po mkha' la 'thor ba'i// dus rabs nag po'i lteb gnyer dran byung //༷ lda li ni rgya gar gyi rgyun zas shigaX man ju ḍi li ni skyabs brjol gyi bod mi 'dus sdod 'khrug cha che ba'i rgya gar gyi sa cha zhiganya ma ha lhan dhi ni dus rabs nyi shu'i das dkyil nang byung ba'i rgya gar rang btsan len mkhan gyi rlabs nyin gyi skyes bu zhig gam 'dzam swā nga steng 'tshe mad zhi ba'i las 'gul spel mkhan gyi grags can skye wa'i gras shig red/— 31 —

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/dga' ma dran thu/ tshoyangs ba'i 'jig rten mun pa'i bla bres kyis bkab cing //skyi ser byang lhag ngar ma 'ur 'ur du ldang dus//snying nas dga' ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs kyi phro la mo //yar chab gtsang po'i shag shag rlabs sgra dang baspyodangs so//byams ldan skyed ma'i mngal gyi rum khug las thodan te/ /skabs gsum 'tshar 'o/nga byung nas da lta yi bar du//lo rgyus ring mo'i lam der phyir 'dang zhig bgyid skabs//chung nas 'dang brtse che ba'i mdza' na mo dran byung //kun gsal bu mo nub phyogs chu lha ru bzhud cing //dbe/nga mtha'i mtshams sprin dmar po'i mdangs cha de rig tshe//mi lo nyi shu'i sngon gyi brtse gdung gi gtam rgyud//'u gnyis 'cham 'cham bskyod pa'i rkyen snang de 'char byung //g.yu 'o( thags su bkra ba'i ni'u sing gi tshal na//khyed sku pad+ma'i 'dab ma mal gdan du bting ste//bcu drug lang tsho'i me dodag gsar bzhad kyi ze'u 'bru//rkang drug kho bos spyod pa'i skal bzang de gang drags//— 32 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/dkar 'jam bal la 'khu ba'i brang gzhung gi mchod mo ra//nu 'bur ngang dkar rgod pa'i gar stabs de rig skabs//'dod pa'i ra ros spyos pa'i las can gyi bu ngas//dga' ba stong gis rol ba'i dga' ston de e ma'o//bco lnga'i dung zla gsal ba'i dben 'jam gyi mtshan der//rdza chu sil ma'i 'gram gyi brag rdo yi ngos su//brtse sems dar gyi mdud pa ma zhig pa'i ri mo/skusnar mo'i khrag gis bris pa'i dam bca' de dran nam//skabs skabs snying gtam snyan mo'i bzi kha la g.yeng zhing //mtshams mtshams mngar zhim cos yi lbu chang la 1dul bzhin//yid 'ong gling kha'i nang gi mdza' gcugs kyi zlos gar//da lta wa ler dran pa'i snang tshul de ci drags//grong khyer 'du long phyogs pa'i khrom ra ru bskyod de//kher rkyang 'chorta ba'i nyin mtshan 'da' thabs shig byas rung //yid kun rnam shes 'dres pa'i chung thothogs ya khyed zhal//yid khams btsan sgyuthong de nas thar thabs ni mi 'dug/chung 'dris khyed la bsam pa'i dran gdung gi na bun//nyin dang mtshan mota gang du bsangs dus ni dben pas//brtse gdung nad kyis mnar ba'i mya ngan gyi bu chung //bdud rtsi sman gyis skyodab pa'i thabs shes shig e spongad//— 33—

gangs nyu3 r+bha brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/dgung sngon mthon po'i dbyings na dal dal du 'phyo ba'i//mngar skyar sems 'khreng khur ba'i sprin dkar gyi 'dab ma//tse/ lo'i ༄pha yul e shes ri grong gi phyogs su//yid 'phrog snying sdug lha mor gtam lan zhig 'khyer ang //de ltar yun ring rig med kha 'thor du gyes pa'i//gtan grog sa snying gi nor bu dbang med du dran pas//ma bcos ngang gis shor ba'i brtse gdung gi smreng glu//mi che'i lam skra/gas lhu gas la lhad med kyis blangs mo da//

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/si skyo gdung gi 'bod pa/dus rabs dmu lha da kyi khrag mchos//gnam sa'i bar mtshams nas 'phyur zhing //gangs ri'i byang khog gi stod smad//shar rlung 'tshub ma des dkrugs byung //dri med a sngon gyi 'dzum zhal//chu 'dzin lang 'o/nga gis sgrib cing //'od snang 'bum brtsegs kyi nyi zer//pad+ma'i babo skal las bral sku nga /mu med byang thang gi dkyil du//'jag rtsa'i shugs glu de gyer skabs//skad brda'i 'gyur khug gis stodangs pa'i//mi kyang rkang gling de dran byung //gdug rtsub sgra gcan gyis ༷tes pa'i//bsil zer sgor phyed de 'phag tshe//gnam sa phyed gshags tu gas pa'i//gzhis byes 11 mtshams de dran pa//— 35 —

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/rab rib cig zhag gis 'khrigs pa'i//gangs la'i la 'phrang gi steng du/ /'khyag ltogs med mug gis mnar ba'i//yul byol bod mi dag skyo ba//zungs khrag sa gzhi ru gtor ba'i//ston mjug 'bru rigs kyi 'bad nor//gzhung khral rgyas bcad kyis 'a'othog pa'i//sku nam las dbang de dman so/nga / /nor lug 'phel kha la sdigs pa'i//khrel 'das gung khran gyi ri spyang //'brog pa'i srog rtsa la rgol ba'i//zhe gnag las thabs de ma11nga ngam /sprel srin gdung rgyud las sbrum pa'i//rma med gangs can gyi bu tsha//pha skad sbyong spyod kyis dben pa'i//zin tho'i bshum sgra de 1stes sam//'phags mchodag 'jig rten gyi mthodan po'i//yang sprul rgyal sras kyi gdan sar//kla klo'i 'dre lag de rkyong dus//klad rtsa'i 'phar lding yang 'gag song //— 36 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/lcags mkhar dgu brtsegs kyi nang du//bkres lha gas mu ges yis mnar zhing //bsad mas btub gsum gyis gtsos pa'i//gangs ri'i dpa' rgod rnams gang drags//mkha' 'gro'i sde nga grogs kyi sa skyong ba'i// mi med 'grog dbo na gyi bya btang //dmar wa'i sdigs dmo da kyi brag chas//zhi bde'i bgo skal de 'a'o/ga so/nga //rang yul gangs can gyi ljo ngas kyi//rang byung sa gter dang shing nags//ma lus spyi ther la gyur pa'i//dus kyi lhag rlung de kho ga dang //lha ldan thodang khyer gyi sdudags bzhir//smad 'asnurang 'du snu gas kyis gasku sa zhing //chang rag skyur rtsi yi ngad pos//dbang rtsa'i 'gul bskyod kyang brid byung //ya khog gangs dkar gyi ri bor//skyo ngal bu yug de 'tshub tshe//bdag med seng phrug gi smreng glu//ti se'i gang 'dabs nas gyer yod//— 37—

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ thol byung gi sems sgra/zang zing 'ur dang ca co'i sgra yis//mi sems dkrug pa'i lha gas ma med pa//lte khrag dmar po'i dngas ma 'pho yul//mngon med dga' bde'i ri grong 'phyongs rgyas//sna lnga byis pa'i sems khams khra mcho na//skyed ma'i grib ma srung ba'i gnyen 14// nyin dang mtshan mo'i stong 'dang dbyings su//brtse 'dzum dgod pa pha ma'i bzhin ras//bco brgyad gachodan nu'i snang ba malnga na snga //sprin dkar sding ba'i nam mkhar do rung //mi tshe'i don snying nor bu 'tshol bar /rgya mtsho'i gting du ma 'dzul ka med//mnar med dmyal ba'i lcags sreg sra mo ra//las snang tsha ba'i reg bya myong yang //gasku na pa'i mi la gnya' shing 'debs pa'i//mi zad khrims de su yi lugs yin//tshe 'dir pha ma'i sku drin mi lcogs//phyi ma thar pa'i lam sne ma zin//chos nor gnyis med sprang po bdag gi/—38 da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/go rim 'chol ba'i mi tshe 'di ltar//malnga na wa'i mi la sprel lad med na// 'jig rten 'di na mdun lam mi 'dug/byas pa'i las la brjed byang med dus//gasku na lnga ra gnas kyang snying po 'dug gam//rgyu 'bras go ldog srid pa'i grong 'dir//rgyu 'acadar dasngo na po'i srid dbang brtan zhing //rgyu dang dbang gis rgyal khab skyodang ba'i//rgyu rkyen de la bathe sa thabs e sku da//dza sa pa'i gzugs kyis chodas min brtsams pa//chodas dang 'gal ba mkhas pas gsungs kyang //chos 'bag gdong la gyon pa'i spyang gis//chos ldan gangs ri'i stod smad khengs 'dug/srid pa'i ljongs 'dir srid la zhen pa'i//brkam chags 〉sgros pa'i gzugs brnyan nag snga// /nub ri'i brag gi grib mar sdeb nas//nyam chung grong sde har gyis bsnubs song //blangs 'das so/ drug nyams len byed mir//mi phyed gus pa'i dad pa ldan yang //bar ma rang snang mchod ba'i chodas pas//sems 'di rtag chad gnyis su spyugs byung //yod tshed gnyis su dogs pa'i las 'bras//yod sku da 'dra ba mkha' yi 'ja' tshon//sku da pa'i bden grub tshad mas 'jal dus//da 39—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 3tshegs bsgrigs/yod pa'i chos su slo thag mi chod//cadan kyang 'chod ba'i bslu brid zhags pas//'bo sa byed bcings pa'i 'kho ra ba'i mthodan wa //bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus//'di nas thar ba'i thabs shig 'chortal dang //'jig rten bya bar snying po med cing //brtan g.yo'i dalnga sa lnga ra rtag pa med dus//sku da tshad rmang nas zhig pa'i bskal mes//khram pa'i 'du khang 'di nyid bsreg na//mi tshe g.yo la sbyangs pa'i skye bor//rnam smin las kyi zhags thag 'khengan nas//rdo rje'i spu gri sngon mo'i rtse mor// sha lpags rus gsum tshal bar bkad na//rang sems gting nas dga' ba'i smru dbyangs//rang bzhin rnam dag ngang nas len cing //rang dbang gu yangs sgo ba'i zhing du// rang byung dga' bder spyad par cis nongs//'on kyang mi rtag 'khor ba 'di na//'khrul ba'i ltad mo 'di 'dra 'dug ste//sdug bsngal tsher shul phung po'i rtse mor//byi'u chung 'jo la mo sa tshang mal byas skad//'dod chags glang chen spyon pa'i 'dre rgod//'pho ba'i lus por rang dbang med stabs//phyi nang bslu brid mdzes ma'i gzugs la//da 40da

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/'khrul ba'i bu rul spyon pa'i gdung sras//balha sa pa'i las la thar thabs dka' ba//rgyal ba'i gsung las lan gcig min rung //da dung bye ma'i khang bur zhen pa'i//yi dgas glen pa nga rang skyo ba//shes rab sbyong ba'i rig pa brtul zhing //legs nyes 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod med po//tshe gcig gzhan gyi bran 11ra gyur ba'i//'khor ba'i dwa phrug nga rang skyo ba//mi tshe rmi lam 'ja' yun 'di la//'khrul ba'i las 'di sgong na 'dod kyang //byedan bo mas las kyi bag chags mthug sngo/sa//sems pa'i rta r+shasnad srab kyis ma 'chun//ngam nag srid pa'i rgya mchorware gting du//las kyis mnar ba'i nyam thag bdag la//spyan ras gzigs kyis byams brtse'i spyan zhags//lan gcig gasku/ ba'i skal ba ldan na//'dod dang chags pa'i gzhan dbang gyur ba'i//rang gzhan gnyis 'phung las kyi chod 'phrul//'di dang phyi ma'i 'phung 'dre de la//bka' rgyas dam bca'i dam 'asnga gas mdzad na//mi med nags kyi phug pa de ru//sngo na med bya btang phyi ma'i don grub//'di snang 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod de//da 41 da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chesnaso 3tshegs bsgrigs/mi tshe grub pa'i 'tsho bar 'byor na//grangs med bskal par sngo ba par dka' ba'i//dal 'byor lus kyi rten bzang 'di la//shes rab ral gri'i masnu na mkhar 'khur nas//zung 'jug yangs pa'i mgo 'phang rnyed na//bde chen snu sa dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings su//sgya ma'i zlos gar sprin phung gtor cing //drong sems rang ngo chod pa'i gnas lugs//stodang ba'i nam mkhar kha dodag mi 'dug/(zhes pa de ni rgya gar byang phyogs mdo la dar gyi ri 'dabs su 'tsho ba'i go rim 'chol ba'i 'khyams po bya dor phun tshogs dbang phyug gis blangs so/)

skyug gyo ba'o 'dzog rten/dran pa'i thu chen/stas rgod khros pa'i sder bzhi bgrad sgras gangs ri'i ri klung yom yom 'gul//sna༄ nag bdud kyi slo snying bsreg pa'i me phung gyen du lang long 'phyur///degs myed dpa' bo'i ya lad rnon pos rgol ngan brag ri gtor na yang //brdong posad+ngha legs gsor kha btags tsam zhig khyed kyi ske la g.yogs myong med//gangs ri'i rang mdog dmar por yur ba'i skyo gdung lo zla'i khug pa ru//paṇa chen bla mar lcags thag brgyab pa'i snying nad sems la mi baXted par//chol kha gsum gyi 'thus mi'i tshab tu khyed nyid gcig pus rgya dmar la//nyes med bla mar skur 'debs mi byed bden tshig 'thodad sgra thog mar bsgrags//mun pa'i sku la bas sa gzhi sgrib cing grang rlung lha da pa'i mtshan mo der//gshin rje'i dpung rtags dmar 1/ btab pa'i las mkhan du mas khyed rang gi/'gros byed rkang par lcags lha ga brgyab nas sha ler 'khrid pa'i gtam ngan zhig/yar klungs gtsang wa'i rlabs dang 'grogs nas gangs dkar ri wa'i khyon du brdol//shin tu chung ba'i mun khang zhig tu nyin mtshan bstud mar gnam thag brgyab//'thotho ba mi yi lus rten yin yang khyi dang phag pa'i rtsis malnga nga dben//thos pa tsam gyis skyi g.yang ba yi sdug sne lha dgu'i rtsub kha myangs//mi bzad duḥkha'i btson khang de ru khyed kyis ma myangs dka' sdug gang //da 43da

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/skabs re zas bcad sngo lha la mdzad pas kha nang gro ga rgyug rtsub mo sa dkrugs//skabs re rang dbang skad 'bod mdzad pas mthag chodan pas gru gur bkyigs//ngan rgu tshang ba'i bce na khang nang du'ang gsum bcu'i dus dran byed 'o/da pa//lhan skyes mkhams gang gis bzi nas rang dbang lha mor 'dod zhin lci/ /dgun gyi kha ba lhab lhab bab pa'i grang ngar che ba'i chodags pa der//khyed rang gcig pur ngal rtsol bskul ba'i skyo glu lhang lhang len zhor du/ /mdzub rtse'i khrag gis snyan ngag bris pa'i 'o/ rgyus zin sngo gso/na po zhig/mun nag dgu brtsegs gra bzhi batho na gyi 'alha ma gang gru bzhi'i gyang lnga ra gsal//dmar po'i me stag srid rtser mched pa'i 'o/ rabs drug cu'i mgo tsam nas//sa ya drug gi las skal phyir du khyed sprodag byung ba'i sdig sdug kun//ma brjed nyin tho'i tshul du btab nas glegs bam gzhi ru bathodad mo da tshe//skyod sdug mchi mas mgrin pa mi brnangs snying khams can gyi skye thod su//kye ma lnga phrag snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byunga'abras rnam gzhag 'chodal ba'am//yang na bden pa'i khye'u ma lus srin po'i kha ru spugs sam ci//sgyu ma'i bye thang stong pa'i gzhi ru smig rgyur zhenab pa'i yu mo khyed//ri spyang dmar po gang gis bdas nas srid pa'i g.yang kha de ru lhags//gces pa'i rang sredag rgyan du bzhag nas me mda'i sku khar khu tshur bsgrengs//dar ma'i na chosad bcesan du bskyal nas mi tshe lcags mkhar nag sngo ra bstims//mi lo bzhi bcu zhe drug ring la gnya' shing 'khur ba'i bran g.yog khyed//baX da pa'i pha grodal phyin pa yin nam ka med las mthar lhang ngam ci//da 44da

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/snying stobs khyed las lhag pa med kyang dpa' bo'i dran gso byed myong med//lhag bsam khyed kyi gong na med kyang bstodad pa'i snyan tshig rtsom myong med//gzi brjid khyed las che ba med kyang 'ja' sa tsam zhig sprad snu nga med//ma rabs 11da mi'i gshis ngan de la rnal ma'i nges shes 'thosangs lags sam//a mdo'i bre ser 'alnga nga gi mig sgras lha mo'i bla mtsho'i rmi lam dkrugs//khams pa'i rgya stag ngar ma'i sder bzhi gangs dkar lha mo'i bzhin la bgrad//dbus kyi gangs seng dkar mo'i gad rgyangs gangs dkar snying la gzan pa'i tshe//gangs ri'i smyon pas khyed nyid dran pa'i sems don yod tshad glu ru bkugs//dge 'phel dbu rtser bsang gasku la btang nas khyed kyi sku tshe bsring na sems//skyid chu sngon mor rlung rta spur nas khyed kyi sku bsod 'phel na sems//'dzam gling rgyal spyir zhu 'bod bgyis nas khyed nyid btson grol thob na sems//yun ring 'dris pa'i bag chaṇa mthug 1/sa lhan 'a1/mas thengs shig byung na sems//mi rabs gnyis kyi mthud mtshams de ru khyed ni thodad mi'i maṣ+ṭha na rtags shig/dus rabs gnyis kyi 'brel mtshams de ru khyed ni rang btsan rdo ring yin//gsar rnying gnyis kyi sgyu la mtshams de ru khyed ni rang dbang gsar gtod mkhan//dbus smad gnyis kyi sa mtshams de ru khyed ni ngo ma'i dpa' cad zhig/mdor na gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung dga' ldan 'o/ brang rgud mtha'i bar//mi rigs snga na du mi tshe hril sngo/ rgya khrims mun pa'i tsher snga nga nang //skyid med sdug gis mug ga sa byas pa'i dal 'byor lus kyi chag sgo zhig/sa steng 'di na khyed nyid tsam las gzhan du la ni yod re skan//da 45—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/hi ma la ya'i gangs ri mthong dus khyed kyi skra lo dkar po dran//rda ram sa la'i nags klong rig dus khyed kyi dpral ba'i gnyer ris dran//nam mkha' lha nga par mig zhags 'phen nas 'das the na gcig la gzhigs pas na//mtshams sprin dmar po'i gdags srib de las khyed nyid rgas pa'i bzhin ras mthong //spyi lo 2003 zla 3 tshes 10 nyin can dhi sgar sman khang du/da 46 da

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/sed/ma nges grangs med gsum gyi snga rol nas//ma rung las la bo mas pa'i shugs wa che//mi sems gasku yis gang ba'i da11na ngan chosas//mi mchodag 7rgyal ba dag kyang bslu snyam byed// phyug wa'i cadar gyis sku ga gis ka ba 'gyel//mdzes ma'i gasku yis dbang po'i dran rig rgud//sred dang nor gyis chab srid skyong ba'i dpon//chos ldan gangs ri'i rdzongs 'dir su yis bkod//rnam rig grung pa'i gzhon nu'i sa bon med//nyams snu/nga can gyi rgas 16re shul rjes med//ci yang nus pa'i dar ma'i snying stobs med//gsum med sog ma'i phung po bod kyi yul//byas pa'i las la dungs pa'i sems gso med//shi ba'i dpa' bor mya ngan gus 'dud med//legs nyes 'byed pa'i mkhas pa phal cher med//'byung 'gyur bod 'dir bzang ba'i skal ba med//da 47 da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/phyi dgra 'dul ba'i pho rab dpa' rgod med/khyod yodar byams pa'i mdzangs ma'i na chung med//bu phrug lharmeng la mkhas pa'i pha ma med/—/skya zad sngo yang sdug pa da lta'i bod//gna' bzang rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i bo mas lugs 'thodar//deng rabs rig rtsal sbyong ba'i slo mig ldongs//gna' deng sku mtshams 'alnga ra ba'i 'phrang lam steng //gtad so med pa'i dwa phrug snying re rje// 'byor ldan bsod nams can gyi gtam rgyud med//sprang rngo srang lam nyul ba'i sgrib nag med//dpa' bo'i tshe sredag brlag pa'i rin pa des//lkog bza'i yo lang rgod pa'i 'tshub cha che// khyim pa'i lugs kyi khrel dang ngo tsha med//chodas pa'i sku la gyi 'dod chung chog shes med//sha dang khrag la rngam pa'i ban 'o/ga chortas//rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i ltad mo 'di 'dra 'dug/nyams len gnad du sgril ba'i dza sa pa med//dam tshig rdo rje srung ba'i slob bu med//dben dbo na byin rlabs can gyi bsti gnas med//snyigs dus bstan pa 'dzin pa'i kha chu gas red//—48 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/sha khrag rus pa gcig pa'i la rgya med//mi rigs ring lugs zer ba'i slob gso med//rang gi ro/na du rgyal khab 'chosang bsgyur gyi//gasnga nga dmar mi yi kha maro/ga de 'dra lags//ming sring rgyud pa bzang ba'i rus zhen med//ma smad byams dungs zab pa'i brtse ba med//pha bu dgra ru langs pa'i 'jigs rung dang //nang dme'i me ri 'bar ba'i dus zing che//shes rig lha 'phar phye ba'i bshes gnyen med//bsnyungan pa dzaṭī rgyun bsnyegs pa3re nya ma med//bag med gtam dang 'chal phyu da 'khrug 'o/nga gis//nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i srin bu'i rigs rgyud mang //rang dbang rtsod len byed pa'i slo stobs med//rang btsan slar gso yodang ba'i 'dun dmigs med//rang dodan 'bad pas sgrub pa'i gasku can dang //rang rigs 'khrodam pa'i rjodar bas nyin mtshan 'chodal//— 49—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ ri grong gi zhogs kadapyid gsum tshes 'bo yi khu 'o///rgyang kha'i ri sngo gas nas grags skabs//mi baX da khrag dodag gi g.yu 'brug/mjo na wa'i mkha' mtha' nas ldir byung //'jol mo'i tshangs dbyangs kyi rol mo//tshang tshing nags 'dab nas 'kho la dus//dgu seng drug 'gyur gyi dbyangs kyi//co ma'i mgrin glu de skyengs so//'jam bsil zhi rlung gi reg byas//ljang bu'i rmi lam de dkrog tshe//dri med dwangs shel gyi sbrang char//ma bskul dang blangs kyis bsil byung //rang byung bde drod kyi nyams snang //dben pa'i ri grong la 'char tshe//ya rabs zhing bo nga gi che rgu'i//gasnga nga mtha'i ut+pal yang bzhad zhag/—50 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/dal balca na so nam pa'i 'du 'god//bzhad gad ling ling gis zodal skabs//g.yag phragag ga'o/la chen yang mgu ba'i//rnga g.yab bar snang la gzengs sosto//zhogs sha'i nyi zer gyi cadad thigs//sa 'dzin babo skal la smin dus//grog ma'i tshang sgor la sgrun pa'i//ri grong 'du tshogs de 'khrug ga/thar thor dud khyim gyi dbu rtser//dar mcho na sna lnga de gamo skabs//bsang gi dud sprin de mi baphrastod//stangs stabs bya lam du 'khyug byung //byin rlabs brgya tshar gyis mi cadams//'o/gas pa'i mkha' rlung gi dbus na//chu len bu mo yi h+phu ngag/gzhon pa'i snying rlung rang min 'gro//mi tshe sa nag dang 'thab pa'i//las skal thod ris su bkod kyang //dang 'dun zab mo yi dgod sgra//dben pa'i ri thang las brgal byung //— 51 —

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/nyi zer ri rtse na bab pa'i//cesags ma'i mtshams sprin gyi 'dabs na//gnag phyug ra lug gi 'ba' sgras//gaskusnan nyams kyi le zhig ster byung //dad gdung rgan 〉spen gyi mi tshe//ma ṇi'i dbyangs 'gros dang rgas rung // dngas gtsang byis sems kyi rtog 'char//tshan rig me tog gis bslus 'dug/

skyug gyo ba'i 'dzog rton/grib ngogs kyai gangs ri/chu 'dzin rba skru nga 'khrug pa'i gur khyim gyi dbus nas//thog ser ri bo bkad pa'i 'jigs dngangs de mthong skabs//drag rlung 'tshub mar 'khril ba'i kun stodag gi cadag 'gyu//mi rtag 'jig rten 'di yi ltad mo la chas song //sos dal bag phebs mi tshe'i dbyangs 'acadas la lha ma zhing //mkhregs 'dzin lta grub mes 16) kha chems la cha 'jodag/gsar bskrun lang tsho ma dar rjes lus kyi phung po//lha 'dre'i rmi lam 'khrug pa'i yul rdzongs de'i dbyibs gzugs//mo lung rtsis gsum gzhung srid skyong thabs kyi khrims lugs//lha gasku la klu ga〈snal nad yams 'asku/ga ba〉〉sa kyi gasku/ rig/rta drel bong g.yag 'grim 'grul yar thon la 'dod pa//gdod ma'i khung bur nyal ba'i mi rigs de'i bla srog/ma ṇi 〉te phung rgyal khab rang btsan gyi mtshams rtags//rlung rta'i dar phyog 'tsho tshis yar rgyas kyi bsngo smon//sbyin sreg gtor rgyag pha rol dgra 'bo ga gi ya lad//gang la gtad so med pa gangs can gyi rdzong gog/— 53—

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas rdzu'i tshig bshad rig gnas dar spel la sprod btags//gru ba rdzu'i spyo spyod dmangs kyi khe phan la ngos 'dzin//slongs dad 'ud sgrog mi tshe'i snying po ru sgom pa'i//shes rmongs zha ril mang ba mi rigs 'di'i khyad chos//rtsam skya'i zas sne mi rabs phreng rgyud kyi lto mchog/tsha med ja thang sgya lus 'tsho gnas kyi brlan gsher//nas chang skyur 31re bam dris srang lam kun khyab pa'i//srin bu'i rigs rgyud 'dus pa'i grong khyer 'dir ltos dang //bka' bstan bang rim brtsegs pa'i glegs bam gyi nang du/ /dkar nag rgyu rkyen mi bslu'i gtan tshigs kyis khengs kyang //las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i sdig spyod kyi skye bor//'chi bdag zhags nag 'osteg pa'i thod skabs shig e 'dug/dbang 'acadar khrag la rngam pa'i mi bsrun gyi dawa na ngan//rgyal srid chu la bskyur ba mi rabs kyi rkang 'dren//rdzun gyi rkyal ba 'khur ba dus rabs kyi khram rgan//rigs rgyud ltong dus med pa'i cho 'phrul de ci yin//rtswa chu'i bang mdzod gtams pa'i rtswa thang gi gzhi ru//gnag phyug ra lug bachothon ma skar lnga'igs la 'gran yang //stong dkrog mar lo med pa'i mdong rul gyi gzugs brnyan//pha khyim sbra nag gru bzhi'i ltas ngan rang min 'bo // —54 —

shar lhu gas kla klo'i dmag gi rdul rlabs kyi dkyil du//gdung sems ma bu 'phral ba'i rkyen snang de rig na//'khreng zhen kha ru lud pa'i zungs khrag gi gsher khus//las dbang lha chosags dag gi thugs tshim zhig 'dug gam//

gangs nyuni r+bha brtsams chos 3tshegs bsgrigs/sil ༷/'i tshig phreng /—thor ci dang no/ltas ngan 'ug pas hab cha dgod pa dang //nga rgyal wa sna/ dud khar rgyal ba sku gas//lung stong brag cha 'khyil ba'i dben gnas 'dir//rnal 'khyodar bdag la 'jigs pa'i thod skabs ci//rang rigs rang gis 'joms pa'i snying stobs dang //pha mgo bu yis rdung pa'i smyo spyod gnyis//mi srid srid pa'i 'acad ba'i rgyal khams la//rigs drug 'khrul ba'i ltad mo ci yang rig/thor ci gnyis pa/lhan skyes khrag la rngam pa'i spyang ki dang //lam lugs dmar sngo ra gyur ba'i gung khran gnyis//phyi zeral gzugs kyi rdzu bag tsam zhig las//nang gi gdug rtsub de la khyad par med//mi sdug srin bya rgud pa'i cho nge dang //dug sprul rda sa'i ban 'o/ga kho skad gnyis//gcig tu bsdebs pa srin po'i ngud mo la//sa yis 'bu srin dag gis mtshar mi 'dzin//—5 6 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/dbang grags lhun 11ra 'gran pa'i mi chen gyi//'jigs rung khro gnyer bsdus pa'i bzhin ras la//gser dngul nor gyi me tog ma bstan tshe//lha mo'i 'jo sgeg dag kyang ngal ba'i rgyu//thor ci gsum pa/mi yi 'jig rten 'asnga da dang chags pas bskrun//'thodad chags gnyis lnga sems kyi rgyu las 'asgyu sa//sems nyid bde sdug kun gyi byung ba'i gzhi//des na sems pa 'di la'ang yid shodan dka'//'theged pa'i rgyu las 'alha da chags khams grub na//sgyu1 morware bya ba dag la ya mtshan ci//lhan skyes dbang po rgyud pa'i gang zag gi //rang byung gshis la gasku sgyus sbags 'di mtshar//thor ci bzhi pa/nor med sprang po ngal ba'i 'jig rten 'dir//nor ldan dpon po'i 'jigs rung mig mdamar//sgyu ma'i bdud sprin 'khrigs pa'i thang stodang du//phar spyang mche ba gtsigs pa'i 'jigs gzil che//rnam rtog 'gyu ba rgod pa'i mtsho klung khrod//mi kha'i rlabs shag thertog pa'i sgra chen grags//bden pa'i dkar ngogs med pa'i mun slongadu//dam pa'i skye bo ngal ba'i dbugs ring shor//— 57—

gangs nyu3 sgru brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/thor ru lja pa/yun ring gshib pa'i chung ma'i gnag sems dang //zhag gsum 'bo gas pa'i mdza' mo'i bsku brid sku gas/ /bud med ngan pa'i rang byung gshis lugs la//kun tu dogs gzon mdzod cig pho skyes tsho//skyes pa dar ma'i pho bakhro'i rdzu bag gcig/sku ngo rgas po'i dngul gyi g.yo bsku gnyis//sprul sku rdzun ma'i tshul 'chos ring lugs gsum//bud med dmyal bar 'khrid pa'i zhags thag yin//thor ci drug pa/sdom pa'i mjug ma ring nas chad gyur kyang //ngur smrig gos kyi rna zhags ring du brkyangs//chodas brgyad dug gis yid khams spyodas gyur pa'i/spyang ki dmar po'i rigs la dog gzon mdzod//cesas pa ngan pa'i sems 'di klu ngan dang //dadze na snga ngan pa'i gdug rtsub las mkhan dalnga sa//bud med ngan pa'i g.yo sgra'i gshis lugs gsum//'di gsum 'dzoms pas ca'ajig rten khams 'di 'khrug/thor ci bdan pa/sgeg ldan mi yi na chung lha sgo0) gzugs//mnyen lcug gar stabs nyal 'gro'i rjes su mthun//skye bo g.yo ba'i zur mig zam zim des//—58 —

skyug gyo ba'i 'dzog rten/khrims kyi drang srong dag kyang 'khyog por gyur//lang tsho'i 'khri shing 'gul ba'i smin legs mas//chags ldan skye wa'i lus sems 'gug shugs ni//pad+ma'i sgrubs na rkang pa drug ldan rnams//ze'u mngar bdud rtsir myos la do zla min//thor ci brgyad pa /bstan pa rgud pa'i dus der bstan 'dzin gyi//skye bo phal cher phal pa'i bya bar g.yeng //chodas la bce na pa'i balcangan sems mi ldan pas//de nyid thob pa'i thob dang skal ba phra//btsan wa kho sa pa'i btsan gyi bka' baspo da dang //ngan pa sdeb pa'i ngan g.yo'i dra ba che//log sgyu na tshang du log pa'i dam nyams rnams//srid pa'i rdzongs 'dir srid zhi'i dgra ru langs//thor ci dgu pa/spyang 31 khrag gis spyodas pa'i dgu gtsigs gcig/ grwa log lha ra gyis 'tshig pa'i ngu skad gnyis//srin bya snyan nas dathodad pa'i sgra skad gsum//mi yul 'di na ltas ngan rnam gsum yin//chung ma lto ga tu nyar ba'i ban rgan gcig/brla sha'i yong sgo len pa'i en chung gnyis//bha ga'i sa mtshams 11ra ba'i btsun ma gsum//da 59da

gangs nyu3 r+bha brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/thub bstan bshig pa'i bdud kyi 'dzad 'phrul lags//rgya stag nags na gyar ba chen po'i snying —//'brong rgod byang du yar ba'i rtsub mo'i gshis//gra log chos 'dres sku/ra ba'i nag po'i sems//srin mo kho sa pa'i 'jigs par lha zla min//thor ci bcu pa/byang shar ri phreng 'brel ba'i rdza bsul na//'brong rgod har sgra sgrog pa'i rngams gzil che//ral gri'i so las rno ba'i khor yug 'dir//khram pa'i dpung cho gas sgril ba'i ki sgras khengs//thor ci bcu gcigaston gyi mtshan mor bser bu rgyu ba des//grang shur ldan yang ston mtshan yid 'ong nyid//dngas ba'i mkha' la zla gastu(na bzhad pa na //dri bza'i na chung dag la skyengs pa ster//yid 'phrog gtam gyi ro dang mngar ba'i chang //mdzes pa lha mo'i gzugs dang pad+ma'i mdangs//ngo mtshar thub dbang bka' dang pad 'byung gtam//mun pa'i 'khor bar skyo ba'i sems gso nyid//da 60da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/thor ci bcu gnyis/ljo na pa'i tshal na khu byug 'gyur khug snyan//dpon po'i drung na sprel lad ngo 'dzum mdzes//dam pa'i mdun sar khrel dang sngo tsha rgyan //gangs spyodan bdag la mi gshis rnal ma mkhe///byang 'brog hor gyi yul dang gtsang stod smad//dbus kyi chos skor dpal dang lto dgas kong //malha khams sa yi thig ler grags che yang //'phyongs rgyas za hor rigs la ji ltar zlo//

gangs spyon 3 brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/smyon pa'i rang gtam /snyan ngag mkhan dzetsware snyan pa mi 11ba cing //tha snyad mkhas pa'i grags pa mi 'bar yang mi 'o/ sum cu brgyus pa'i shul ring las//mthong dang myong ba'i gtam gyi sgo mo 'byed//'jam po'i mal nas zug pa'i tsher ma dang //rtsub mo'i rdo bar 'khrungs pa'i rang 'byon dang //gshis legs mdza' mo/sa bslus pa'i 'khrul snang des//'jig rten 'di na rnam gzhag byed par dka'//mi tshe 'khor ba'i nyi ma ring po dang //'tsho ba'i bslu brid dbyar gyi 'ja' tshon ris//lang tsho'i bab chu 'khyag gis bsdams pa'i dus// sems kyi ngang par skyo ba'i snang ba 'char//phyug po'i bu la khrims sgo med pa dang //dpon ngan rgyud la snying rje med pa dang / /nyam chung mi la mabo/na skyabs med pa rnams//byung nas mthong ba 'khor ba'i ri mo lags//dge sdig spangs blangs 'chol ba'i sku ngo yis//sger gcod khrims sgo btsan pa'i rnam smin 'bras//nyam chung 'bangs kyi mabos la bab pa des//—62—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/rgyu 'bras bslu med zer bar yid re dogs//rgyal khab shor ba'i dbul phongs mi ser dang //rtswa kha zad pa'i ri dgas mas ma gnyis//mi dang dud 'gro'i tha snyad tsam zhig las//nang sems gdung ba de la khyad par ci//pha ma'i kha 1/ra brlag pa'i bsku/da zad can//bdag dbang gzhan la sprad pa'i bran gasku ga ma//chung ma byi 11sa brku ba'i khyed mtha' rnams//snying gi rus pa gas pa 'dra 'dra red//sdon pa'i mdang khar sprum pa'i ri dgas dang //dpon ngan tshang la 'khon pa'i mi chung gnyis//thub dbang lha mi'i masprodan gyi spyan ras cadag/srog la nyen kha 'phrad pa 'dra 'dra re da//chen po'i ngo srung byed pa'i sprel lad dang //sprang por kha gnyer byed pa'i byed las dang //ཿthos min cesas su 1—ga pa'i gamotho sgyu'i las//ring mo zhig nas bdag gi gshis dang bral//'jig rten dga' ba'i nor gyi stangs rag dang //sku ngo dgyes pa'i ngo stod snyan mo'i gtam//bla sprul mgu ba'i gser gyi maṇ+ḍal kun//bdag gi yid sems mug pa'i sprin nag yin//mdza' ba'i grogs la rings pa'i phyi thag dang //drin can pha mar bsti stangs bkur bakhro'i las//ming sring sgyu mo ra brtse ba'i dngas ma can//da 63da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/lan gcig mi lus thob pa'i don go chod//thos pa'i nor la 'dzad mtha' med pa dang //bden pa'i 'bras bur bslu ba med pa dang //'chi bdag drung na ltag sgo med pa des//lhag pa'i mi tshe la 'di la sems gaskusna 1/ba mi chodas mkhas pa'i sku ngo rgyag lhag dang //ring lugs med pa'i pags byi'u mdog ngan la// dus dang gnas kyi khug sku re re na//rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i gshog pa re re yod//srid pa'i srid la zhen pa'i ban rgan dang //sdig pa'i g.yang bkug byed pa'i bshan pa'i bu//'o/ga mal snga na mo/ra nyal ba'i dar ma rnams//da1gas wa'i gshis la thegel ba'i 〈sna ba yin//mang po'i khrod du rdzu yi mig 'phrul ston//gcig pur lus tshe zhal zas brku bar mkhas//lkog bza'i rus par rngam pa'i bya rgod tshogs//kho ga pa rnag gis bathe la bar byin gyis chodabs//lha yi drung du bden tshig smon lam skyor// bdud kyi gam du lhas byin gtsug na bkur//lha mi'i rigs su ma 'dus 'dre rgod tshogs//spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul bas 'dul bar dka'//bden yod rlung rta rgud pa'i bar chad dang //khram pa'i dgra lha mthe ba'i 'jig rten 'dir//drang po'i mi la bde ba'i lam med pa//—64—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/gdod nas grub pa'i 'khor ba'i chos nyid lags//bla dpon 'byor ldan khros pa'i sdang mig dang //kha mang mi ser sdeb pa'i dpung phyogs kyis//dam pa'i skye bor rgol ba'i gshis lugs der//bskal pa'i mthar yang bcadas pa'i re ba med//tshul min tshul du bathe sa pa'i chodas 'o/ga dang //bden min bden par cadag pa'i dasngo na ngan dang //dkar nag sodag par 'grel ba'i khram rgan rnams/ /nag 1tshere spyi cho gas shig gi srung mar codas//rigs mthun bo gas dang bral ba'i 'khreng sems dang //drin can ma dang bral ba'i sdug gi 'khur//bsku da nams zhing dang bral ba'i lha gdung ci//bdag gi mi tshe 'di la ma malnga nga med//'asnu ba'i rgya mchorta brgal ba'i mtha' ma la /sngon med lta ba'i nor bu bdag la rnyed//gtam dang mi kha'i rba rlabs drag na yang //ngal ba'i rkang bgrod byed dgos sngon gyi las//dpa' sngo sdar ma'i bzhugs gral bo 'o/ga dang //bzang ngan las kyi rnam gzhag mkhar sprodang zhig/gser gyi ri la rnyang ma'i ldebs zhal 'di//srong btsan rigs rgyud 'chol ba'i ltas su snang //mkho tshad bzang ba'i ltas ngan rim pa dang //byas tshad bden pa'i 'phrul snang rab rib gnyis// smig rgyu chu ru zhen pa'i 'du shes rnams//— 65

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/snu ga gi cangab skam pa'i me stag yin//zas ngan skor gyis lus bongs ston pa dang //dug gis nying khus sems kha sbrid pa gnyis//phal pa'i mi yis bajothod tshul tha thad kyang //shes rab can gyis gzigs na khyad par med//gom gsum spo bar sgor gyi yong sgo dang //lung gsum mdo na rdzu yi gar 'cham re//dus rabs brtsegs mar dmangs khrag 'jib pa'i srin//'phrul ba'i klu btsan rnams la zhe re mer//bo nga ma lha yi rigs dang bla sprul tsho gas//dman pa sprang po'i khyu dang khyim pa'i rigs//bar mdo'i mgo bo rmongs pa'i rig 'phrul 'di//mabo nag cadad yul ma galta gas gang na mchis/ /gangs kyi ri la seng ge mthong ba dang //dga' ldan mthong su zhing khams rig pa gnyis//lha mo'i bla mchodar 'ja' khyim bzhad pa gsum//ya mtshan snang bas kun gyi yid khams bzi//dpal ldan lha mor zhal mjal zhu ba dang //gnas chung rgyal pos lung bstan mdzad pa dang //sme na lam chen mor gtor rgyag byed pa rnams//rgyal khams skyodang ba'i 1—la lugs yin lha skad//drang pos gcig tu bsdus pa'i srid dbang dang //lugs gnyis gasku yis bskyangs pa'i byed las dang //dasdil phyug mtha' gnyis gyes pa'i dmangs gtso'i sredal//—66—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/bden dang mi bden rnam gzhag su yis 'byed//lha chodas mi chodas bsres pa'i sku lang gcig/rdzun dang phra ma sdeb pa'i than ltas gnyis//skya ser gnas yul brje ba'i ltad mo gsum//gangs ri'i rgyal khams rgud pa'i skyel ma yin//mi bsrun da1/na rngorware bka' dang 'gal ba dang //bdud kyi grogs dang dam tshig log pa dang //khor yug ngan pa'i las 'phro rdzogs pa dag/rang gi lus kyi sgrib pa dag par 'dod//mdzes ma'i 'alhu/ngas la zhen pa 'o/ga pa dang //'gyig gi 'chos bar 'jigs skrag skyes pa dang //nya ma chung mi la snying rje skyes pa rnams//rang gi lugs kyi stong nyid rtogs par 'dod//sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mi la ras pa dang //srid kyi mnga' bdag sku/nga btsan mi yi rje//rang dbang rgyal po stag sna 'jigs bzang rnams/ /drang rngorware mi yis dus kun bkur bya lags//byams sems can gyi pha ma'i spyodan lam dang //las srog dor ba'i dpa' bo'i yid pham dang //༄brtse bas gdung pa'i mdza' wa'i mig chu rnams//las kyi rnam smin dag las btsan par sku/ga/2004/6/28nyin 'phags yul du bris/da 67da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs gzhi grub pa nas de ring bar cha tshang ba'i mi gcig kyang byung ma myong ba der ngas mi tshe hril por slo pham byed bzhin yod/da 2 lta gangs spyon/da 68 da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/skyug bro ba'i 'jig rten/'jig rten/kla slo dang mun nag mthun sdeb kyis mi bsrun khyodad pa'i gar stegs/dam pa dang nyam chung gi tshe srog rlung rtser spur ba'i bar do'i bshas ra/'jig rten/khram pa'i mig zung gis mchodad pa'i dalnga na ngan chos cad sbag gis nyin mtshan 'chodal ba'i dgun mtha'i spyi gling /dad zas dang sko ra zas kyis lus thodangs tshon pa'i bla sprul chos chos brgyad kyi 'gying 'alha sa cadam pa'i mi rabs kyi thang skya/'jig rten/dbul phyug mgo snyoms bral ba'i skyo glu shub shub zlo sa/lan chags kyi bu myongan mang 1/sa bde gshegs kyi gzungs gzhug gshags sa/'jig rten/gson 'dre dang ro langs 'thab pa'i 'khrul snang gi yul ljongs mog po/dug tshal dang bam ro spungs pa'i rab rib kyi sa nag leb mo/'jig rten na/garo/da ma'i rmi lam la 'khreng pa'i mkhregs 'dzin gyi lta grub kha ba bzhin nyil la/sku da tshad deng rabs kyis bslus pa'i nyams chag gi ce 'phrul bye rdul bzhin 'tshub/'jig rten na/ pha bu nor rtsod kyis g.yul chen bshams pa'i ltas ngan khu tas sgrog cing /da 69da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ma smad phrag dog dang mig ser g.yo ba'i dar nag wa rgan gyis 'phyar/'jig rten na/ 'chal po dwangs sang dbang po'i 'khrig spyod kyi ngan gtam 'thor rlung gis 'khyer zhing /smad 'tshong rgod bag can gyi lha ga yi dri ngan chil ler 'thul/'jig rten na/mdza' gcugs kha bral sku nga ba'i sdug yus kyi mchi ma klung rgyun bzhin stems la/mi rigs gnya' gachodan gyis gtses pa'i dus rabs kyi skyod gar dug mcho bzhin 'khyod/'jig rten na/bu rul chodas a ma'i mthod skra brngas nas mdza' mo'i skra tshab tu khyodan pa'i ltas mtshar 64byinatra/ 05/srid don pas zol ma'i kha g.yang kho da mi rigs kyi bden thodan gling ba'i zhabs gzhas 'khruga'ajig rten na/ dug gsum gyi mig 'bras 'o/ra kha bzhin hur rer gdangs sku da la/phyogs ris kyi yo lang me ri ltar tshag tshag 'bar bzhin 'duga'ajig rten na/'byor ldan 'gran rtsod kyis ngal ba'i ngal dub kyi dbugs ring hal zhing /mu to ba 'khyag lto gas kyis mnar ba'i na zug gi smre ngag grags/'jig rten na/drang bden la mabo gcadan mo da pa'i skyod shas kyi zin chod mthug la/gasku ga gasku ba la gzigs gamo la che ba'i gleng 'thodas kyi hab cha lha da/'jig rten na/dung zhen gyi nang snying gas pa'i thodad rgal gyi dri rtags dmar la/—70—

skyug gyo ba'i 'dzog rten/ja lan du gcin skyag ldud pa'i khrel 'das kyi ngu bshum grang /'jig rten na/la rgya la rma shul zab pa'i dpa' rtsodad kyi yid mug 'khyil zhing /sems shugs la sgrog thag bsgo na pa'i yar thon pa'i dngan pa 'phyur/'jig rten na /'tsho ba glu ru len pa'i snyan ngag pa'i 'dang rgyag mchos rlabs bzhin khyodam la/snang brnyan ri mor brko ba'i sgya rtsal pa'i phangs sems ri rab bzhin rtsi/'jig rten na/ ༄shāmod sems dang sdang mig gis pha rol rgyud pa'i slog zhags shig shig tu 'dar mi kha dang ngan smras kyis gzhan sems dkrug pa'i sprin nag rngams shing mthuga'ajig rten na/mi rkyang kher bsun gyi rkang gling bar med sgrog cing /mgon med dwa phrug gi skyo glu lhang la 'bud yod/'jig rten na/khrag sbyor dang gdug rtsub gdon 'dre'i skra tshogs ltar gzengs yod la/'o/ga lta dang tshul 'chodas stag gzig gi kha ltar gdangs sku/da/'jig rten na/skyug wa ba'i 'chos brnyan gyi 'gyur bag nyin rgyun lha da la/las 'bras khyad gsod kyi gshed sgra 'ur 'ur du bsgrags//

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ rlabs chen gyi rjes thul/(mu mtha' med pa'i 'tsho ba'i 'khyag kyung khrod/ 'bar bzhin pa'i mtho spang gi me lce sngon mo/)da wakha byang gi 'grel/'jig rten gyi go rim ldog pa'i nyin srib tu/gangs ri'i dpa' lha da kyi dngan pa mkha' mthar 'khyil zhing /'jag rtswa'i shugs glu dang rkang gling gi ngu sgras/gnam sa'i sems khungs su 'tshub sha bslangs/red angad lha na kha de brel rtab tu slebs pa'i dbang gis/me tog la snying 'jags thob ma myong la/jag pa dag chu mchod bzhin bathe la ba'i rkyen gyis/khyed kyi na tshod smin pos ga la lcogs/klu khang pa/ lo 'go 'dir/sa sku sa kyi mun pas khyed kyi mig ljo ngas bsgribs shing /mtshams sprin gyi bslu mdangs wa ta la'i yang sngo ga la 'tsher skabs/khyed gcig pus gnam sa'i skyi lpags dbral dbo sa la/khyed gcig pus gangs 'dabs kyi gtam rgyud gleng dbo sa stabs/dgra bo'i mdun cog tu khu tshur brdegs pa'i brag cha/—72 jo

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/ches snga mor grags rung dus de ring yang ha nang gsal/ha cang gsal/klu khang pa/ khyed rang /gangs stodangs kyi gas chag la sems snang lci ba dang /yig drug gi 'das gasku na la dungs pa zab par brten/g.yu 'o/ kher bzhud kyi las dbang khyed la sbrum zhing /yu mo skom gdung gi na zug khyed la smin/khyed la smin/de ltar/ dgos dbang gi la rgya gcig dang /cad ma/ mi nub pa'i rgyan mtshan zhig gi phyir/khyed kyi brang gzhi mchi mas brlan zhing /sma ra dkar po rlung bus bdas rung /kha ba'i srab mthug dang rtsam skya'i las dbang ched/dung pa'i mig zung ltod myong med cing /gces pa'i ngar skad kyang 'jags ma snurang / gtan nas/da dung / gangs ri dang rtswa thang / jo khang gi rdo gcal steng du/khyed kyis lus po 'gre ljo ga brgyab ste/khyed kyis ngu ngag dbyangs su gyer te/srung ma dmar nag gnyis dang tse/ rgyan pad+mar/brag srin gyi gdung sras dang sku nga btsan bang so'i/las skal la khrims gtugs dang rgyu 'bras la brdar sha bcad pa/da 73 da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/bgrang gis ga la zin/ ga la zin/ gsan byung ngam/ 3༅ khang pa/btsag ser lha da pa'i dgun gzhung /mun 'egeng 'khyil ba'i mtshan dragagangs rdza nyil ba'i nyin nagakhrag rlangs 'thul ba'i dus rabs der/grang rlung gi 'ur sgra rgyang ring rgyang ring nas grags shing /spyang chosags kyi ngu zug thag nye thag nye nas gyer skabs/gnas de'i skyod gar dus mtha'i mcho nag bzhin khad kyis bathe la la/bam sreg gi dud sprin lha sa'i mkha' dbyings nas 'tshub ber 'phyur/'tshub ber 'phyur/'phyur shul de na/ ma ṇi sna blta sa kyi nag dreg 'khyil zhing /mchodad rten mabo med kyi mya ngan stems/dur khrod 'di ru/ ro langs stong phrag gi 'o dod sgrog cing /pho brang bdag med kyi stong sangs drags/da dung / mun pa'i slong du/khyed kyi mig chu skyid chu'i rlabs phreng dang gcig tu sbrel zhing /khyed kyi skyo ba byang thang gi kha ba dang lhan du nyil/dkar shig shig gis/kye ma/ mi rigs kyi pho nya khyed/kye kye/ dus rabs kyi dpa' rgod khyed/— 74 —

skyug gyo ba'i 'dzog rten/nam yang mi nub pa'i rang khyodan ltar/kun gyi dran ngogs su lhang nger 'char nges la/gtan du mi 'jags pa'i rbab chu bzhin/sa ya drug gi mkha' dbyings su drag tu 'phyur srid pas/dal gyis babs dang / gtsang chab lags/rtsod kyis bzhud dang / klu khang pa//na cin/dkar bong bong gi gzugs brnyan zhig las/nges don gyi rang dbang dben stabs/ las dbang gi rlung shugs dang 'grogs te/skabs 'gar dal zhing skabs 'gar 'khyugamatshams re/ brag ri mchodan 1rware mgul bar dar yug bzhin bkrag la /lan rer/ zhing thang gru bzhi'i phang bar dud sprin bzhin 'tshub/gang ltar yang mi rnams kyis khyod nid wasnying po med pa'i mtshon dper ngos 'dzin byed//

gangs slo sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ snyan rtsom khag gnyis/gcig bsam gzhigasprin pa zhig gi bzhud shul du/char thigs ni ha cang 'bab dkon pa'i lha i zhal chab dang 'dra rung /nam mkha'i pha rol du nam mkha' gzhan zhig dang char pa zhig yod chog na/dpyid ka med pa'i yul ljongs shig kyang yod dgos nges red/sngo lems lems ni gtsang yi kha dog yin 'os pa lar/ta ba tangang pa rnams dal bur 'phur 'os rung /ko gru bar snang du sngo ldem mer bying ba/nam mkha' la rgyu dag med pa e yin//spyi lo 2003 zla 4 tshes 18 nyin/gnyis/ bcon pa/char rlung dang grang reg khrod bsdad drags pas/nyi 'od dang 'ja' tshon la shin tu dung /drod khol spar mo gang gi slad/lang tsho lcags mkhar nag por bstims//—76 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/phyir dran khrod kyi skyed ma/zla ba gza' yis bzung pa'i mun nag gi mtshan hrul de ra/ 'u tshang gi lhas rar ches thog ma'i ri spyang gi 'jab lha la lha gdamar long long gi zungs khrag dang bya rgod kyi gshog rlabs 'thab pa'i sgra/snying 'jags rtswa thang gi ri klung kun tu 'khyil/dus de nas bzung / a pha'i byams dung ma reg pa'i dwa phrug khyu zhigalas skal gyi thu cadag tu rum dbo sa pa khyed dang khyed kyi brtsams chodas/a ma lags/ 'jig rten mi cesags kyi rgya maces chen cesare nang /khyed rang / dka' sdug gi rlabs kyis 17ma pa'i gasku ra gru bzhin/khyed rang / ngal dub kyi skya bas mnar ba'i ded dalnga na bzhin /ma bsru gzhan tsho dang mi mtshungs pa'i rlung rlabs gshags dgos byung /de bas/ 'chod ba'i lha chen la snyi nga rje dben pa dang /mdun lam gyi nges stodan par gya gyu mang bar brten/dbul sgyu ngas kyi khang drul 'di na/bu phrug tsho'i las dbang ched du/khyed kyi lang chodar 'ja' chodan gyi bkrag mdangs 'tsher ma snu nga la/khyed kyi mi tsher bde skyid kyi nyi zer 'phros myong med/kha ba sngar bzhin 'bab rgyun drag cing /— 77—

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrogs/sngo nub kyi nam zla ha cang grang / a ma lags/ 〈sna khyi'i zug skad las ci yang mi grags pa'i mtshan gzhung du/lā sgron gyi 'od snang chung chung der mig zung cer te/gces phrug su zhig gi lwa bar lhan pa glan chodar/yang bskyar rtsam sgye rnyid do der kher lab ma 'bus sam/bden te/ byams sems kyi bdag mo lags/mi tshe rmi lam gyi 'ja' yun thung yang /skyo ba mtsho klung gi bzhur rgyun ring song /rnam smin gyi dpyang zam dog sner bkug te/slar yang rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi lag rten sngas gzhir g.yar dang /mi yul na sdug bsngal rten 'byung gi gtam rgyud mang zhing /'tsho lam du skyid sdug re 'khor gyi 'gyur bag rgod pas/khyed kyi mig chus gsher ba'i bzhin zla/sngar bzhin nga'i lo zla'i mkha' ngogs nas sim por 'dzum byung /de ring / gtan du mi bzhu ba'i kha ba leb mo zhigakhyed kyi dbu skra'i nags ljongs su lheb lheb tu zags zin la/bgres rtags kyi gnyer 'o/ re re'i srubs ka na/bshul ring gi rngul chu'i 'od mda' ha cang rno/a shu re/ 'o/ zlas zad pa'i bdag gi skyed ma ya//—78 —

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/sa srod kyai rtog 'char/nyi nub dang mtshams sprin gyi mkha' cardog tu/nub ri nag sku ra mo ra gtsang chu bzhin/dben 'jags rtswa thang gi pang khar dal bur bzhur/bsil rlung dang 'dab chags 'phur shul na/zla ba'i gtam rgyud mjo sgang gi dben thang la sbrum skabs/be'u skad dang yig drug zlos pa'i sgra/ spang thang na 'khyil zhing rdza chab las grags/dus tshigs derd wadung zla'i gsher thigs las dkar ba'i cad bzhun/sbra nag gi srubs ka las 'a11ra skabs/na chung ma'i glu skad je malnga nas je ma10/ stag shar pa'i ho ga 'char je mang nas je mang //— 79

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ rtswa thang /ljang mdog gi 'jig rten/me do1ga gi dga' tshal/dngas gtsang gi yul ljongs/ de ni/gnam sngon po'i 'og tu mdzes shing sdug la/sprin dkar po'i 'dabs na yid du 'ong /e ma/ rtswa thang /khyed ni srid pa gsum gyi rgyan cha/'gro ba'i yid kyi gdung sel/sa gzhi mdzes pa'i macesar lwa/gangs ljongs skye dgu'i gces nor/da dung /'bu srin dang 'dab chags/ri dwags dang bung ba/rtswa dang rtsi shing la sku/gas/skye dngos yod do cog dang /sems can tha dag gid waskyes pa'i ma/byams pa'i gnyen/mched pa'i yul/— 80—

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/dungs ba'i zla cadags kyang yin pas/dpyid rlung ser bus khor yug gi rmi lam dkrog dus/khyed rang ldem ldem gyi gar stabs gamo ba'i tshangs pa'i sras mo dang 'dra/sbrang char zim bus chodar 'dzin ma'i bzhin ras bkru dus/khyed rang g.yu mdog gi lang tsho bkra ba'i na chung mdzes ma dang 'dra/khu byug rgyal mos 'gyur khug gi sprod h+phu len dus/khyed rang me thodag gi mgul rgyan btags pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gathe mo dang mtshungs/red lags/khyed kyi sgeg pa'i nyams dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs/mtshar ba'i lang snu /yang ba'i gom lho bas ni/dri za'i bu mo'i 'gying 'gros/lha yi dga' ma'i stangs stabs/dbyangs can lha mo'i ldem myur dang /kun nas mdza/ngas/sku ngas su 'khrul/gcig tu snang /der brten/spang rgyan me to/ga dang /gangs lha me togari skyes me togamacho kha'i pad+ma rnams kyis/dga' ba'i glu dbyangs khyed la bskul zhing /skyid pa'i rkang bro khyed la dung /da 81 da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrogs/zhen chags kyi zur mig khyed la 'phangs/lhad med kyi brtse ba khyed la gtad/ gsan dang / rtswa thang lags/g.yang dkar lu gu'i 'ba' sgra/gyi ling rta pho'i 'tsher skad/bre ser 'brong gi ngur ba/rdzi cad gachodan nu'i la gzhas/da dung /sbra gdang gi g.yer dril dang /be'u'i 'ba' skad/'brog mo'i bzho dbyangs gsum pos/khyed kyi bka' drin la lhag bsam gyi bstodad glu gyer bzhin sku da la/khyed kyi lang chos la la rgya yi sme na tshig skyodar bzhin 'duga.a/ rtswa thang kye/ pha yul gyi rtswa thang /khyed nid mi rigs kyi phugs bsam dang mes rgyal gyi bang mjortad lags pas/khyed rang gtsang gsum gyi kho lag sngo gas shing gra rgyas kyi rba sgra dgung la 'phyur/khyed nid yang mes kyi shul bzhag dang 'byung 'gyur gyi tshe sku ga kyang yin stabs/khyed kyi rin thang la brjid rlabs che zhing gsar gtod kyi mtshon mdangs rnam par bkra/khyed kyid grangs yas pa'i rtswa rkang re re'i rtsabar/— 82 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/gna' mi'i dka' sdug gi rngul khrag thim sku da la/khyed kyid rtsi rtog gi 'dab ma re re'i steng du/mi rigs kyi re ba'i mig chu yang 'khyil sku da/da dung /khyed ni nim ljang gi ma ma zhig yin pas/rtswa thang mi dmangs kyi yid mug sel bar nus shing /khyed ni me ltasneg gi pha sa zhig yin pas/rtswa thang gi gzhon nu tshor 'dang brtse yi mngar kha bskrun par the bas/de bas/ rtswa thang ya rtswa thang /khyed med na chung chung lu gu 'tsho sa med cing /yang chung me tog 'thu sa dben pas/'bri g.yag gi 'phel kha dang / cang shes kyi shed shugs gsar ma ni/byis pa'i sgrung /blun po'i ngagaspyon pa'i bsnyu da pa las ma 'das sku /des nad wang rang dga' sa ni khyed yin la/nga rang 'khreng sa yang khyed nyid yin/pha yul gyi rtswa thang kyed
