gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrogs/ kher rkyang gi sems 'gyu/khyed med pa'i mtshan mo ra/nga'i mkha' dbyings hril po stong sang nger/zla ba 'tsher mi 'aro/da pa'i rkyen gyis/mtshan smag gi 'dze da rngam sngar las mthu/nga / kher rkyang du lus pa'i skar mda' bzhin/me ho ga brgya phrag gi skyed tshal 'di ru/khyed kho na'i ched du bzhad kha 'dzum/ dus der/'jam rlung gis bskul ba'i rtswa lo'i shag sgras/gnag snum de'i ngang tshul gleng skabs/chu 'gram gyi me thodag ser chen/'dris che ba'i 'dzum kong de'i 'ja' brnyan e yin/sa sku da las zab pa'i dus tshigs 'dir/sdong lo las yang pa'i sems pa lhags rlung gis 'ded cing /dgun ngar las hrul ba'i nam zla ru/me phung las dmar ba'i brtse ba snying khong du rum yang /ci zhig gis cadangs pa'i nga rang /mya ngam gyi bye thang na/ 'jigs snumags kyi tsher sa ru/— 84ba

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/bdag med kyi rnam shes dang / keng rus kyi rdzog 'od bzhin/ byang thang nas 'phur zhing ri 'dabs su yan /snying sdigag lags/ lo zla kha bas mnan zhing sems pa grang ngar gyis gzir ba'i dod dathodang /rgyun gtan gyi sdong rtsar/ lhan 'dus kyi dus chad ltar/re sgug gi lo zla mdzub rtses bgrang zhing /lhag bsam gyi dung zla brtse 'dzum gyis bsus te/snying gtam khyor ba gang khyod kyi 'phur shul du mchod /ra bshams rung /zla zer las grang ba'i dran gdung zhig dang /kher rkyang las zab pa'i rma kha des/nga'i mig chu dgu tshigs kyi gtsang rlabs dang lhan du skyodam pas/khyed kyi brtse sems she'u chung gi yul kher dang gcig tu gtses nges//las dbang /mkha' dbyings kyi sprin dkar ni rlung bus bdas/'jig rten gyi rnam pa dus kyi sgyu nyas gyur/ mi tshe'i bde sdug gi kha lo ded walas dbang gi lha mo/sa gyur ba khyed kyis shes sam 1da 85 —

gangs rjerdzon gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ gsom rwardong /su zhig gi sems bskyed 'khur te/khyed rang / dus bzhi'i nam mkha' na/sngo ljang ljang gi gdugs gur phab/de ltarabyedamigs 'dun gyi calab brtan zhing /gzhan phan gyi 'o/ 'dab stug rkyen/kher rkyang gi 'dab chags mo da sngo /khyed la 'khor zhing / khyed la sding la/sgyu rtsal gyi bzi yod du mas/khyed la smon cing / khyed la bstod//

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/khyod dang nga /'jig rten 'di gu lha ga drags pa'i rkyen gyis/mi dzargags rnams 'tshang khas dub/lha na kha skam sngo zhig gi srang masnga ra/khyod dang nga /'phur mi 'dod pa'i sdong lo bzhin/stes dbang gi gling gar sding /sems pa chung chung gnyis rte'u dkar po ltar/rtswa ljang dang sku 'dab kyi phag tu wa sa/ci'i phyir khyod rang 'ja' tshon bzhin/nga'i dbyar gzhung nas yud kyis bzhud/nga 'di ltar sbrang char gyi rkang rjes 'ded zhor/ri sngagags gzhan zhig tu/spang ljo ngas steng rmi lam rgum//

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyosnags bsgrigs/ brtse gdung /lang tsho me phung ltar dmar skabs/su zhig gi sems khungs su/rang byung du brdol ba'i glu dbyangs/nam yin yang gyer cesag dzar+shag yin/brtse gdung / bde skyid kyi bzi kha yin la/brtse gdung / sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi yang yin/ lhan 'jortams kyi dus tshigs dbo da sgras bsus shing /'byung 'gyur gyi ched du g.yar dam 'jog skabs/ khyod kyi sgobs pa ri rab las mtho zhing /khyodad kyi la rgya mchoja mo las zab/brtse gdung / bde skyid kyi bzi kha yin la/brtse gdung / sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi yang yin/gyes bral gyi nam zla mig chus brlan zhing /gas chag gi sems pa rlung gis 'khyer dus/khyod kyi don snying rdo bo las grang zhing /khyod kyi rin thang shing bal las yang /brtse gdung / bde skyid kyi bzi kha yin la/—88 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rton/brtse gdung / sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi yang yin//dam pa'i sangs rgyas/gtan cirgags shig gi thu sner khen pas/shes rab kyi zab sar bstims/rlabs che ba'i nyin tho'i shog lhe re re/smon tshig dang sprin dkar ltar/sems can gyi mkha' dbyings su 'aX zhing /dmyal ba yi bar snang du lding /ngo ma/ dka' sdug la 'dris kha skyen pa/khyed la dbang ba'i sgya rtsal yan gar ba'am/sdurnyi na/ khyed kyis babaskrun pa'i bya gzhag ldog med cigagan 9sdugs tha dag glu ru gyer phod pa'i 'jig rten gyi h+phu pa grags can khyed/yod tshad gzhan ro/na du sreg dar+sha sa pa/gang la gang 'dul gyi bca' khrims//

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ dran snang mog po/nam zla cadags pa'i stodan mtha'i mtshan rum du/nga khe ru mar gtsang 'gram du tho yor bzhin 'greng /phyir dran thengs shig gi ngu bshum skru nga na/mig chu rdog po gcig dang dngan pa ring po zhiga'akhyag sib sib kyi mi yul 'di nas/ri bo'i pha rol du yib pa'i lha bya gang der/mdang dbo nga / sbi rag gi bzi kha rkyen pas yin nam/yang na/ dran 'char gyi gdung ba zab pa ci/snying gtam yod tshad zla ba'i tshes ris la bzhon te/snyan dngags ljang khu zhig ston rlung dang mnyam du 'phur/dus der/ zla ba dang ston rlung gi hrag bar na/kho mo'i sil tog gi bzhin 'dzum sngar bas 'tsher la/ston rlung dang zla ba'i 'chang rol nas/kho mo'i yang g.yo'i rkang stabs kyi rol dbyangs lhang lhang du grags//—90—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/gangs ljongs kyi gtam rgyud/gdod ma'i ri brag gi klad na/sprel srin las mched pa'i tshe 1teg ldo ma sngo /mkha' mtha'i skar chogags kyi grangs /ra bsres te/yar klungs skyor po'i spang khug nas brdol/sa gnam gyi dbye kha mi gsal ba'i sku 'bo der/kher rkyang gi rna ma shes mo da wa /su yang slebs ma myong ba'i lung stodang de nas/a pha'i rkang rjes lam bus bdas shing /a ma'i zungs khrag brlan gsher du 'gams/dus de nas bzung /gangs ljongs kyi gtam rgyud gsar pa'i dbu khyud bshams shing /bsil ldan gyi rtogs brjod cig gi brjod bya 'khrungs pas/rmig sgra khri 'bum gyi brag cha dang rdul rlabs/ sprin nag 'khrigs shul gyi nam mkha'i phar rgyab na 'phyur/da dung / dus rabs khri 'bum brtsegs pa'i lteb gnyer nang /rgyal kha dang gru ngag kho nas gangs ri la gson shugs sprad stabs/— 91 —

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/spri na dkar gyi rang mdog la 'khyud pa'i yul ljongs 'dir/mes po tsho'i bang so'i 'gram du/ me tog gi 'dzum sgeg grol/bsang dud kyi 'dab lo bzhad/ smon lam gyi sgra brgya ldir/rjes dran gyi skor bro 'khyab/yin na'ang / rgyun gtan ma yin pa'i mtshan 31 der/ri spyang dmar po'i 'dur rgyugs shig shig tu rgod cing /rnam shes 'khyam po bar do'i 'phrang lam du 'dzing skabs/dwa phrug dang yu mo ngu shul du/las dbang zhig la khrag gi tham ka btab/skad cig de'i yang mthar/go la'i gru zur gyi mun nag khrod/chag dkums du cadar ba'i sems pa khyu des/na zug gi rma kha snyim pas skyor zhing /sdug bsngal gyi mchi ma khe/ga tu mid kyin/sku da lnga'i rgyang bzhud la thodam kha gtad/dbang med du/

skyug gyo ba'i 'dzog rten/re cig thar thor/dus cirgags nyu) bsam gastunog khesad/phye leb 'ga' brel sha langs/nyi 'od med la zla 'od kyang dben pa'i/bas mtha'i 'jig rten 'dir/rlung rta dmar po mkha' la lheb lheb tu 'phur/da dung / ma ṇi'i dbyangs rta dang rol dbyangs gzhan zhiga.a ma kho na'i spyodan lam/gangs nyi si'i gling skor na brag cha bzhin lding //

gangs nyu3 3 brtsams chedzeso 3tshegs bsgrigs/ zugengudotshan cad chego/mdza' na 31/las dbang gi mdzub dkris sor rtser balha na pa'i sa srod der/'u gnyis kyis ches chodag ma'i brtse gdung la mchodad pa'i bsang dud khyodan mo /spyodan lam grangs med dang lhan du mkha' dbyings su 'phur/skabs de dus/ khyed kyi snang ba skar chortags las brgal zhing /khyed kyi smra stod sil rlung las 'jam/da dung / snying gtam sna chosags kyi gsang tshigabarjod mi tshar ba'i lha sgrung gi rtogs brjod dang /brjed mi srid pa'i byis sems kyi 'ja' brnyan ltar/bdag gi lang tsho'i nyin deb nang 'phyo zhing lding la/khyed kyi sems pa'i rtsig ldebs su mdzes shing bkraganangs mor/ dung zla sgor sgor shar ri'i phrag gong las 'dzum skabs/sems pa dmar chung bkra shis gsang gling du brel/dga' dgod lhang lhang / 'jo sgeg ldem ldem/ brtse 'dzum shig shigamakha' rlung dngas mo ngad pa'i mtshan ljo ngas su/brtse ba lhad med gcig gi me kha gasku zhor/— 94

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/skor bro lding / bzi kha 'khyor/ dam bca' 'jogadran e byung / mdza' na mo//gnas de na lang chorware gsang ba yi khye'u sprum sku da la/'jig rten mi yul gyi zin sngo gdodad sku da/gnas de na brtse 'dzum me lta ga gi 'dab ma lhab lhab tu bzhad sku da la/rgyu 'bras khyad gasku da kyi mig chu ltems ltems su 'khyil sku da/lhag par/ 'u gnyis bral kha'i snga nub tu/khyed kyis mi ga chus gsher ba'i sngo gdong la/ gson shugs dang mdzes sdug gi cho na ris daskadan zhing /'dzum mdangs dang spro tshig gi drod snang dben stabs/ brtse ba'i chu gzhung snyeg pa'i gser mig bdaga.a sdug dang 'u thug gi tsher shul 'grim dbo/sa pa khyed kyis e shes/de ring / phyi rol na yul rdzongs med pa'i sa sro da mog por/do daspo nga / bo nga 'dabs na grags 'gul med pa'i dus tshig skya mo ra/skya thang thang gi de'u 'bur thed bo de'i gong khar /kho bos/ re sgug gi mig zung mkha' mthar cer zhing /brtse sems kyi drod rlabs snying khar rum/de ltar/ sems phrin dmar dze zhig gi slad/yun ring / re smon ljang gu de'i ched du/zla ba'i byang kho ga na rmi lam 'thung skabs/— 95 —

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chetshes 37gas bsgrogs/brtse 'dang las sprum pa'i mchi ma'i thigs phreng re re/gangs ri'i phar rgyab kyi brtse lhar/skyems chang ngang btegs shing / gdung sems kyis ngus//2002/na/14nyin bris/ da 96da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/'brog mo/ khyed rang / rtswa thang gi phang bar 'khrungs shing /me rke(ga dang mnyam du bzhad pas/khyed kyi 'dzum mdangs chu skyes las dmar la/khyed kyi snying gtam ze'u 'bru las mthu/khyed rang / g.yang dkar gyi 'ba' sgra'i khrod du 'tshar zhing /dngas gtsang gi mkha' dbugs dang lhan du bsrings pas/khyed kyi gshis rgyud bal dkar las 'jam zhing /khyed kyi lhag bsam so/ maces las dkar/khyed rang / sbra nag gi drod khol las rum zhing /mar rtsam gyi 11 bcud kyis gasku/na stabs/khyed kyi snyan pa 'bri mo'i bzho dbyangs dang song ste bar snang du ling la/ thabadi ཿpa khyed kyi brtse ba rtsi ba'i me phung dang sdeb nas gangs khrod du 'bar//— 97—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ stag shar pa/stag shar pa/brtse gdung la u tshugs ma skyon/'dun mos ni su la'ang dbang bar nges/stag shar pa/las 'a'o/ la yid ches mjo da dang /khyed la mkho ba gang du'ang gdam chodag chodag red/stag shar pa/'o/ lha da kyi mig chu galta nga mi nyan/brtse gdung la bslu brid shin tu mang /stag shar pa/bud med ni 'dod pas phyug stabs/ga dus yin yang khyed la sgug srid/stag shar pa/bu mo tsho'i khrel dgod kyi slong na/ci'i phyir khyed rang pus tshugs su 'greng /stag shar pa/lang tsho 'ja' tshon dang 'dra bas/mi tshe la gtan tshigs 'alhu ga mi rung /stag shar pa/—98 —

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/brtse gdung la yid dam bcol yang /dpa' brtul gyi la rgya dor mi 'os//gagis ༷/bkas/(tshan pa brgyad/)mi yul/tshul 'chos dang g.yo bsku rgod pas/drang bden la bo sa phra/dam pa/mi kha dang sgro skur sdeb pas/mi tshe skar mdang la 'gran/rdzi bo/'bri g.yag gi las dbang sgo ma pa'i/gangs skru nga gi cadan pa las ngan/sprin pa/a ྅gen gyi sham lwa/sbrang char gyi pho nya/'ja' tshon/'tsho sdod kyi tshe yun thung yang /lang dza la bkrag mdangs 'tsher/—99—

gangs nyunye sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/myos rgyus/kha sang gi byad gzugs mngon pa'i me long /bod/ma ṇi dang bsang dud kyis sgrib pa'i yul rdzongs shigathodad mi/yig drug gi ro/la dbyangs las mi shes pa'i sgyu rtsal mkhan//da 1slob

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/ḍūrdogs pa'i dus ྅9/nam mkha' dang skya rengs kyi gzhi der/skar tshogs ni phon mdog med pa'i/mig zung grangs med dang 'dra bar/sprin pa zhig gi rkang rjes las yal/sdong lo la rlung bu 'khril nas lding skabs/chu thigs kyis/ cadad lam lam du/'tsher bar mi byed/ re re bzhin sa la zags/sngo ljang ljang gi ngos su/ me tog ni/ lha mo ltar sbrang bu'i rmi lam du ldem zhing /mi yang rang nyid kyi brel 'tshub cig gis bslus pas/zhogs pa'i dus su/ thag ring gi rmig sgra ha cang gsal la/zhogs pa'i dus su/ dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsashin tu bde//

gangs nyu3 3 brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ mtho sgang gi rdzi bo/dben thang thang gi lung khug de nas/mi tshe las dka' sdug ring pa'i lo zla sring skabs/char rlung dang cig rgyu 'thab pa'i la rtse na/khyed kyi lang tsho la dar lcog gis 'phya brnyas byed/grang ngar gyi mdun du me thab la gces shing /kher rkyang gi skabs su si glu la g.yeng /da dung / mtshan mo mang cad zhig gi mig zung sgrim te/ri spyang la rkang pa 'jab kyin/bya glag gi ga31ga sgrar blags kyin/skar chosags kyi las dbang la 'khreng sems lci bas/ngag rgyun gyi ri nyag de ru/ki ring dang 'ur cha brdegs pa'i sgras/gzhis bdag gi rmi lam dmo(gasnum snum shig shig gi spang ljongs ngogs su/me lta ga las mtshar ba'i bu mo gcig gis/spang rgyan me do/ga gi ngang tshul gleng skabs/—102—

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/yang bskyar gyi dus tshigs la/zla ba med na sha zan shin tu mang bas /u khu1 ston pa/bde stong gi bzi khas myos pa'i ldom po/bud med kho na'i khrom srang myul te/ci zhig la rngam pa'i ri spyang ltar/phag gru'i nags spyodang gi zab sar/da dung yang / su zhig la sgom bzhin yod//

gangs nyu3 3 brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/gtsang chu'i dzogs hūṃ/nam mkha' lang 'o/nga du 'khrigs/ sprin pa nag po gtsang po'i mkha' ru 'phyur/gtsang 11 kha sang nas bzhur kyin pas/ngal dub kyi rngul chu gnam la 'thor/nya mos brjod tshul du/gtsang wa la glen rtags mo da pas/rlabs sgra ni rgyun gtan gyi ca cad zhig yin cadas rung /snyan ngag pa byis pa ltar/gtsang ngogs su rlabs sgrar yid smon byed cing /snyan ngag pa bu mo ltar/zla 'od 'og tu dran gdung gi mig chu gtor//

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/po ta la/ zhogs pa'i nyi gazlo na gyi zer thigs/dpang mchod ba'i rgya phibs la babs dus/gser ltems ltems kyi 'od mda' non po/'dzum byung / lha sa'i mkha' dbyings nas/po ta la/ gna' mkhar rnying song de'i lo rgyus kyi gzi dpal dang /dus rabs kyi 'gyur khug zung /gzhi gcig tu sbrel ba'i rgyug chu bzhin/go la'i rdza gting na drag tu 'phyur skabs/dran byung / ches snga mo'i dus kyi/po ta la/ mes po tsho'i rngul khrag gis sprum pa'i/skyid sdug gi gnyer ma shar shur re/gangs dkar gyi bgres rtags e yin/mthong byung / sprin dkar gyi bang rim la zug 'dra'i/po ta la/ sa sku da kyi mun pas sgrib nyin/shar mtha'i rlung dmar gyi 'tshub kha nod cing /gangs ri'i rlung rta mar 'grib kyi rmi lam zlum po/lha mo'i bla mtsho'i rlabs ris ltar mtsho khar skyodam stabs/da 105da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu skar gyi tshom chen sa la bsna la ba'i mtshan dgung du/grags byung / thag ring gi khyi rgan rgya'us/ sngo ta la'i/ rgyal sras chung chung zhig gi the ga sgrar/'khreng sems dang skyel ma bsres ma'i zug skad skyar mo/dgon pa'i mkhar rnga las dran snang lci bas/ ༄mtshan mo der/ spyan ras gzigs gnam la 'phur sku nga zer/mtshan mo der/ spyan ras gzigs sa la bab sku nga zer /zla 'od 'og tu/zla 'od 'og tud snyan ngag pas mig chu galta ra ba'i rjes shul dmar sangs drags la/brtse gdung gi khye'u sgrum pa'i gsang ba sdong yos sgrogazla 'od 'og tud ri spyang gi 'dur rgyugs thodad pa'i mtshar gtam rgad wa sa gleng skabs/khyo shug gi gsang ba lci ba'i myong byang rgad mos brjod/zla 'od 'og tud kher rkyang gi bo ma sgra sangs ba'i gtan tshigs lha khyis sdudas shing /a ma la dran gdung zab pa'i bden lugs de 'o/sa shes/zla 'od 'og tud da 106da

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rton/lam 'gram gyi ༷/ ches/mi tshogs lud pa'i lam chung du/ —'dzum mdangs dang mig mdas bslus pa'i phrag lha nga zung yang mor brdar skabs/stes dbang gi sems gtam bsdus sngo /5015dang rwa ri805phyir mig thengs gcig gi las 'a11sa/yang bskyar dgod 'dzum shig shig ha cang 'jam zhing snyi ba'i ngag sgo/dri bachodan ltar nga'i dran shing gi yal 'dab la 'khril zhing /sbrang char bzhin nga'i sems khams kyi zhing sar bab rkyen/rmi lam thun gcig gi sdong rtsar/re sgug gi bzhin zla slar yang 'tsher bar sgug/

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/dran pas dungs pa'i lha mo/bsam gzhig gi 'egeng las 'khrungs shing /dad 'dun gyi mkha' na 'phur ba'i/lha mo ste/ byams brtse yi bdag mo kye/mi chosags khri phrag gi snodan lam dang /lha phyag grangs med kyi dog sgra'i khrod/khyed kyi 'dzum mdangs/nyi ma'i bde drod las 'jam zhing /khyed kyi byams pa/sgron 'od stong phrag las bkragatshes cha der/ re smon gyis skyil ba'i lha dar/skar mda' bzhin khyed kyi sku pang du 'khyug skabs/ gsol 'debs kyi bskul ba'i rol dbyangs/nam yin yang bde snang gi 'gyur khug lhang lhang zhig dang /dus gtan du mi yul gyi sems gaskurware lam sngatho zhigadamar lhem lhem gyi lha na cadad 'gram du/sngo long long gi bsang dud dkyil na sa/da 108da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/ khyed rang / dal ltod ltod kyi nam mkhar 'phur dus/ngas/ 'dren byed rig rig gis khyed la blta zhing /ngas/ sems pa dung dung ngang khyed la phyogs te/dus nam zhig gi nam zhigaches rang dbang gi zhing khams de nad wasnying nye ba'i khyed kyi bzhin 'dzum mjal bar 'dod cing /gdangs snyan pa'i khyed kyi gdam ngag nyan par khyod/a/ lha ces lags/'a〈snar ba na mun nag snangad pas/nga dkar ngogs kyi dmu thag snyob mi thub la/'jig rten na 'dam rtsodab lud pas/sems can rnams skyi ya 'alha da kyin gda'/da dung / dmyal khams dang bar ro/ na /

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/rang dbang / lkedran gdung gi 'bod pa/sems zhabs kyi re glu/lhang lhang / lhang lhang gis gyer/mun pas gtibs pa'i mchod sgang gi mtshan sgyu ngas/kha ba bzhin grang la sa gzhi bzhin 'khyaga'adab lo bzhin ser la me tog bzhin rnyid/rang dbang med pa'i nam zlar/drag char la snying rje bral zhing /bu yug gi 'tshub long rgod pas/a ma dang nyi 'od kyi drod rlabs snyi mo/ga dus yin rung /lhang lhang / lhang lhang gis dran/'jam thing thing gi pha yul gyi rtswa thang steng /dngas grung nger 'chos ba'i so/ga chags rnams/zhi bde/ zhi bde kho nar re bcadal zab pas/rdzi bo'i gling bu la 'khreng pa'i sems pa khri phragadaga' yal ler me jo ga gi 'gram chang 'thung /da 110da

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/a shu re/ sngosan pa 11na thal/me mda'i sgra skad kyis/pha yul gyi snying 'jags dmo gas/'jam cag ger yur ba'i nga'i nags skru nganarlung po bzhin sding la rgyug chu bzhin brel/rang dbang la chag grum sna ra nyin/yu mo dang dwa phrug gi khyu chortags tsho'i/skam rnyid du song ba'i mchu 'dab las/smon tshig dang ma ni sdudas pa'i sgra/ha cang skyur sil sil/ skyur sil sil/re snyeg re re/mu tig gi phreng dog ltar brgyus rung /zla 'od la dung ka dben stabs/rang dbang de/ mun pa ltar/nag thing nger/ da dung yang /bdag gi las dbang dang shin tu ring /khu byug gis/dpyid dpal rtag tu 'thodad/'jam char gyis/ ljang lor dran shing 'jogame tog de dbyar gzhung nas bzhad dus/—111—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrogs/mi rigs 'di gdung yus gyi bar du 'tsho/dus bzhi'i 'jam rlung / —sgo 'gram du rgyu/rtsam dri dang mar ngad/sge'u khung las 'thul/dkar 'khyil ler/ gangs seng gi cardo bzhun mngar mo /sku ltems ltems/a ma bstan ma'i cod khro'i kha ru skyodam/ ri spyang dang bya 'ug 'thab pas/ngu skad tsor tser/yod tshad kyi yod tshad mya ngam thang ltar skyo/ga sa gang nas ga〈snan 'dre skra chosags ltar zing skabs/gangs 'dabs kyi rnam shes khri 'bum/kha 'dab dang bang so'i las rim la 'phyur zhing /rtswa thang dang sbra nag gi grib ngogs su ngus/bya khu ta'i skad ngag 'dzer po/rang dbang med pa'i lung shur na/lhang lhang / lhang lhang gis grags skabs/sems pa 'di/ rkang gling la 'khyud de/lus sngo yang / dben thang la 'khril zhing /—112—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/thag ring thag ring gi ri zhol du/dgon pa'i chodas dung gi skad sgra lhang lhang der phyo gas//se long nang /me long ni rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid red ces/snyan ngag pa 2sag gleng /gang zag tshos rang nyid me 'o/nga nang cad shes shing tshul 'chodas sbyangs/bu mong snuto me 'o/nga mdun du sems pa mugame long nang rang nyid kyi mtshon don rtogs dus/rtog ge ba snums sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab la zhen chags spangs/me long nang 'byung 'gyur gyi tshon mdangs 'od shig shig 'a'o/sa/me 'o/nga nang kha sang gi gtam rgyud skyar sil sil dag rigame long bskyur dus rang nyid gang pye yod pa shes rtogs bral/me 'o/nga 'jig pa'i gang zag cho sa rgyu 'bras yang 'jig pa'i gtan tshigs 'jo ga/

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrogs/ 'khor ba'i lam ci/bde skyid chos sgron/ khyed rang soms dang /lhag bsam dang 'thab rtsod me ri ltar mched dus/'ja' chodan gyi bsil grib bskyar nas 'phur song /bshes gnyen gyi gdam ngag rdor nas 'phur song /nga rgyal gyi g.yul sar sdigs nas mchodangs skusnang /rlabs ltar 'khrug pa'i lha sa'i bar skor du/nyi 'od tsha drag gi zigs rlabs khrod/chodas thodas dmar ser khyodan pa'i btsun ma chung chung /sems shugs dang ngar shugs zung du sbrel ba'i 'bod sgras/mi chosags dang lha chosags kyi bya khyu dmo/ga skabs/spyang lto gas las rgod pa'i rgya dmag gis/khyod kyi nywa ma rgyas pa'i lus po/dug tshal bzhin drud nas thal ba bzhin 'phangs/bde skyid chos sgron/ khyod rang soms dang /mo 'og ba4te lnga gasku na kha ma'i a ma'i gces phrugabla ma'i gdam ngag ma sgyu gas pa'i 'kho ra ba'i btsun ma/gdug rtsub dang mnar gasgu da kyis nyin mtshan 'chol zhing /—114—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/bkres lto gas dang 'jigs dngangs kyis nam zla bgrang skabs/mun pa'i ther+sha khang gru bzhir sems pa rnal lam/gangs kho da kyi me lta ga dmar chung /kha sang / khyod dang 'phur tshul gcig pa'i sgo da dze chodas/brag dmar gyi them skas galta ra zhing /sprin nag gi bang rim brgal dus/rlung gi spu gri 'khor ba'i mkha' dbyings de na/kho tsho'i rngul chu dang zungs khrag gis gsher ba'i ljang lo tshor/rang dbang gi gang bu bzhad pa'i gtam rgyud gang sar grags/bde skyid chos sgron/ khyod rang soms dang /nyam thag dang skyod gdung gi 'o/ zla'i nang /sngo tshal dang chu grang gis 'tsho thabs spyod pa'i nyin mor/khyod kyis btsan lha la gyi snying lha bas dang rgyal gces kyi la rgya ma ro/ra/khyod kyis rgyang ring gi phugs bsam dang chodad sems kyi dar mdud ma bzhigs stabs/a ma bgres mo btson khang gi sgo phyir sgug yun ring nas/'khreng zhen gyis drag tu lud pa'i ngo gdong gi mchi ma de/su zhig la mchodad sbyin dang sna blta sa yin/dus bzhi'i char rlung gi gdong bsu des/sge'u khung gi lcags dra rgas rung /khyo dad kyis lha ljo ngas la re ba'i mig zhags/da 115da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/khrung khrung gi gshog 'dab la 'khril zhing ldem na/sang lo'i dpyid rlung gi 'gyur khug khrod du/ tshe srog gang mang 'dus pa'i drod rlabs de 'khyil mo da mes/bde skyid chodas lha na/ khyodad rang mu mthud sku mas dang //(mi gshis khral khrul dang 'gro ba mi'i spyo spyodad gdug rtsub kyis lus gcong bzos pa'i chab zur btsun ma ngag dbang dbang sgron gyi las dbang 'grel ba/)rgun chang /dga' dus mngar mo dang /sdug dus skyur mo/mi yul na/ khyed kyi 'khrab tshan shin tu mothod cing /kher rkyang la/ bzi kha'i zin cad ha cang mthugad dung / stag shar pa'i pho tshod dang /dman shar gyi mig chu kha mo1sa/'tsho ba'i skyes lhar 'dri rtags dang cadar rtags btab rkyen/chang btung na 'jig rten gyi zhabs 'dren red zer/chang med na sdug bsngal la sems gasku bral zer//

skyug gyo ba'o 'dzog rten/skyid zur lags/ sprang wa dang nyam thag mod pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/khyed kyis gser ṭaṃ dang brjes pa'i lang tsho sku drag dang lha lcam gyi rkang mthil bar na ngal/skyid zur lags/ dus rabs mo/ga mo ga gcig gi ltag rgyab tu/khyed rang / skyod ngal ral thod zhig gi mnar gathe da kyis/mi tshe las dka' sdug rtsi ba'i gtan tshigs the ga sngo/sa/kha ba las grang ba'i yul sgyu ngas der lhags/dathodas dbang gi la rgya de'i ched du/ khyed kyis/rang nyid rang gis bslus pa'i sems gzhas phra mo//ston kha de'i dus su/mi ser kha shas sme na lam dum bu re'i lag rjes 'jo ga.e red/mtho sgang gi lug khyu dang sprin dkar gyi 'og tu/khyed rang dus bzhir g.yo ba'i 'jam rlung ltar/sems can gyi phyir dang mo da tshad kyi phyir/skyid zur lags de ltar sgo zur 'bud pa red ang //da 117da

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/gangs ri'i snang ban+tawa/gna' snga mo/ zhig gi sa sku/da du/gnas de'i sku da tshad shwa cadad kyis bsna la ba'i skyin thang bzhin/skya thang thang / skya thang thang de'i pha rol na/bya rgod kyi snum tshir dang spyang mo khrag gis bzi ba'i 'khyedar 'acadas/mun nag la kha 'o1 dben pa'i bden rtags cad ma yin/sbra nag rlung gis 'khyer ba'i be'u tshe zad mas/a ma'i mal thul gyis bslus pa'i khye'u'i las dbang skyodar skabs/skar 25gas kyi gdung sems mchi mar brdal ba'i drag rlabs/sprin pa dam dum gyi ngu bshum dang lhan du byang mtha'i mchorta khar 'khyil la/lo ngo stong phrag gi na zug jo khang gi sgo them du bsnyil/e dran/ bar skor na sprang po mod pa'i lo rabs der/rgan rgon skor gcig gling skor ru 'khreng sems sgrug gin/ma ṇi lag skor gyi lding shugs sngar las myur/sngar las myur/kha ba da dung 'bab kyin pa'i do dgong /rdzing 'jags med pa'i zur kha 'di ru/—118—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/bar snang na kher tsog 'gying pa'i po ta la /stong cha yod tshad smag rim dang smreng ral gyis ltems/mtshan smag zab/ drag rlung lha da/ rmi lam 'byur/a a/ rmu thag la cangamadud g.yab dang /yid dam la skang gso/la galta ra dang /gangs ri gas nas khrag mchos ྅nil grabs 'dugarigs rgyud stong nas lcam sring sdeb nyen 'dugartsam dri yal nas zhabs dri thul nyen 'dugad dung / me lta ga dang ma ṇi ston mjug gi ri ngogs su ci yang dben stabs/'gro 'ong zad sar gtugs pa'i 'brong rgod dang 'brong mo ya/'chi gasku na gyi shul lam stodang pa'i stag sna ༷dang klu khang pa/mying dang nga'i yul rdzongs 'khyag klong du 'tshud nye bas/〈snag skyodabs dang / las skal gyi lha chen 11/'chi khar gtugs paci) ༷ stag sna 'jigs med bzang po/༷ klu khang pa tshe dbang rab brtan/

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ lha sa/ mtho sgang gi rnam shes/gnam 'kho ra 'o/ rtsibs brgyad/sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad /ri lha/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/chu mo1 yan lag brgyad ldan a lha /de las kyang thodan zab pa ni/dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas mchogegakhyad du 'phags pa'i zhing khams/mngon par brjid pa'i yul gru/ltos dang /po ta la'i rgya phibs nas gser 'od 'tsher zhing /gtsug lag khang gi lha mchodar las bsang dud 'phyur skabs/nor bu gling lnga'i me tog gi skyed tshal dang/ra mo che'i bya skyibs kyi yul rdzongs ni/ci 'dra'i mdzes sdug gis spud cing /de 'dra'i rin thang gis brgyan pa zhig red ang /de bas/'bras spungs kyi mthong grol dang /se ra'i rta mgrin/—120—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/dga' ldan gyi gser gdung gsum ni/61 rgyus kyi gzi dpal bkrag la/dngo sa byung gi byin rlabs mnga' bas/bod mi'i sems khong gi rten gtso gcig dang /gangs ljongs mi rigs kyi bsam sna 'dus yod/'on kyang / skabs shig ring /dus rabs kyi rlung 'tshub dang /yo rgyus kyi zang zing /dmag 'khrug gi dud sbug kho da/lha sa/ mtho sgang gi rnam shes khyedad spyod gar gyi gtam rgyud cig gis/nyin mtshan gyi dbye ba bathe ma drags pas/brjod mi tshar ba'i sdug gtam gyi yang snying /mdang dgong yang me mda'i sgra skad dang /lcags thag gi sil sgra de'i dbang gis/gsum bcu'i dus dran dang /snye mo'i 'os langs/dgu pa'i nyer bdun la so/gas/'o/ rgyus kyi dodan snying zab cing /dus rabs kyi 'gyur khug gsal ba'i /rang dbang 'thab rtsod kyi las 'gul de dag nid 'dzam gling lo rgyus thog byung dka' ba dang /mi'i rigs kyi gtam rgyud nang mchodang daskadan pas/da 121da

gangs spyon sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/nga tshos dga' ba'i bzhin 'dzum gyi me tog grol 'os pa gcig dang /kho tshos spobs pa'i sems bskyed kyi gnya' bo 'greng rung ba zhig ma yin nam/a lha sa/nyi 'od kyi grong khyer/grong khyer gyi nyi 'od/gangs ljongs kyi tshe 'bar/tshe 'bar gyi sgron me ste/kha ba dkar po'i mnyes gshin gyi 'dab sku dang /gangs dkar ri bo'i brtse sems kyi mchod me ya/nga tsho'i sems kho nga nas dungs pa khyed yin la/nga tsho'i yid srubs nas 'khreng ba khyed nyid yin/mdor na/ shar phyogs dang nub phyogs gang du yang /khyed nid mi yul gyi dag zhing dang /'dzam gling gi rgyan gcigabasil cadangs kyi gasku/na snying zhig la/kun gyis kha 'cham zhing /myongangs kyis chog mthun pas/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nam zla dang /'ja' chosan gsar bzhad kyi dus tshigs su/khyed kyi/btsan gnon gyi lcags sgrog sil bur gtor nges pa ma zad/khyed kyi/gdug rtsub kyi ske lha tshal bar gshag nges pas/—122—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/khyed kyi/mun nag gi yol ba dang rab rib kyi seng ras ni de bas kyang dbral nges red/gsan byung ngam/ lha sa lags/gzhis lus mi dmangs kyi rang btsan gyi g.yar dam dang /yul gyar mang tshogs kyi rang dbang gi chod sems nid wardo rje'i brag dang /gser gyi sa gzhi/lcags kyi tho lum/zha nye'i gong bu yin pas/rang srid rang skyong dang rgyal phran mnyam 'brel lam lugs kyis bod mi'i re ba 'grub mi thub pa ma zad/bod don thag gcod ni dus nam yang byed ga la thub/nyon dang /nga tsho'i pha gsod pa'i lag dmar/nga tshorware ma bkum pa'i gshed ma/nga tsho'i gnyen gtor ba'i dgra bo/nga tsho'i yod tshad kyi yod tshad bcom pa'i/rgya dmar gung khran tang nid mi sha 17sa nas ma tshim pa'i/srin po mngon sum gcig dang /༄ mi khrag bzhibs nas mi cadam pa'i/'dre gdon gson po zhig yin song /dbu ma'i lam dang bod rgya zhi 'grig gi re kha /—123—

gangs nyu3 3 brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/sangs rgyas kyi dbe|ngas gzhi tsam las sems can gyis sgrub ga la nus/yin na'ang / 〈sna ma pham gangs can gyi gcasnan nu/yid ma zhum sku nga btsan gyi tsha lnga /srid pa'i chos nyid la dar rgud yong ba bden nges na/mi rigs kyi las dbang la 'phel 'grib yod pa los yin/1— ma/mchog gsum gyi thugs rje'i chu 'dzin ling ling du g.yo ba dang /rgyu 'bras kyi bden pa'i sbrang char zim zim du 'jo na/bod mi'i mngon gyur gyi lo rgyus gsal 'os shing /rgya mi'i 'khyog brjod kyi rdzun /ba brdol bar nges pas/nga tsho'i mdun lam la mdzes sdug gis khengs skusnad la/nga tsho'i rgyab rdzongs la 'od snang gis gtams yod/nga tshos/rang re'i mi rigs la rang dbang thob phyir/nga cho sa/rang re'i rgyal khab la rang btsan len phyir/pho zad mo la gtugs/lag zad dpung la slebs/sku zad rkan la lhags rung /nges par gces pa'i rang srog dor bar phod cing /phangs pa'i lus zungs yang bskyar bar slobs/rgyu mtshan nid ༄khyed kyi lo rgyus kyi shog lhe re re'i nang /—124—

skyug rgyo ba/ 'dzog rten/thodad rang btsan gyi bden gasku la bsgrags gtam 'kho da sku da la/khyed kyi rgyal rabs kyi glegs bam re re'i nang /14da rang btsan gyi zab gsang gter yig gis bkang 'dugad dung /rig gnas chung ba lnga'i tshig 'bru re re las/rang btsan gtsang ma'i gsal kha blta da pa dang /rig gnas che ba lnga'i don sne re re'i nang /rang btsan gtsang ma'i rab byed baspo da sku da stabs/sngon gyi tshe yang bod dang rgya nag nid chodas mo na gyi mdza' dung las mnga' kho ngas kyi 'brel ba med pa'i/'o/ rgyus kyi bden dpang yang /66gnam la nyi zla zung gcigs la btsan 〈sna da11na zhang /rgya rgya yul na skyid/bod bod yul du skyid/mi red ang / lha sa lags/nga tsho rang dbang gi ched du gasku na cadas shing /nga tsho rang dbang gi slad du 'chi bar 'dod/rgya dmar gyi gdug rtsub ji ltar che na yang /cadad mis mthod thod ye nas skur mi srid la/thungan pa'i rlung 'tshub ji ltar ldang na'ang /bden pa'i mar me nam yang nub thabs med/’der brten/ nga chodas/dka' ba rgya phrag khyad du bsad de/—125—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ngal ba stong phrag 'khur du blangs nas/dpa' ngar gyi h+phu sgra dang mdun skyod kyi dgod sgra sgrog bzhin/rgyal kha'i kha g.yang dang yid ches kyi shugs glu gyer bzhin/pha yul gangs ljo ngas kyi phyogs su 'asprod/ma yum bsil ldan gyi zhing la 'bo /rang yul chos ldan gyi phang bar 'gro/rang btsan gtsang ma yi gnas der 'thod//2001/10/111nyin bzhugs sgar rda sar bris/

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rto na/brtse ba zhig gi snga gub tu/mkha' mtha' ring pa'i nub ri'i phrag thodang nas/dmar sgo nga sgo nga gi nyi thigs sa chen gyi snying khar zags dus/mtshams sprin gyi bsku brid 'a21sa pa'i ri klung kun tu/lang tsho'i khrag shed kyi 'dzum mdangs sngar las dmar la/ri rab dang gtsang chu'i pha rol du/skad gru dang ngang ba rnams dmar 'o/nga 'o/nga gis nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur/dung 'o/ ma/nyi rdul bzhin bar snang du 'phyo ba'i khyed kyi sems/re sgug gi gtsang 'gram du chas srid la/skar mda' bzhin thodag mo nga du 'khyug pa'i bdag gi yid/dus rtag tu khyed kyi 'degs 'acadag la nyan nas sku da/snying mthun ma/'jam char gyi drod shas brlan pa'i zhem ljang gi gzhi der/rkang drug gi gcadag rlabs 'khreng pa'i me lta ga gi ra bar du/khyed dang nga yis brtse gdung gi skye skar la 'khyab pa'i skor bro gang mang /bya khyu dkar po ltar gnyis /'i re sme na gyi nam mkhar gtor skabs/zla ba dang skar chodags kyi dalha da sgras/—127—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/mtshan ljongs de'i snying 'jags dal bur dkrogs/ dal bur dkrogs/brtse chang ma/de kho na'i ched du bzhur ba'i mig chu snyim mthil la zags rung /grung ril ril gyi 'dren byed las da dung gsang ba ci zhig 'tshol zhor/mgo bo dang khar sbyar nas brtse gdung gi gtan tshigs rdo bor ma brko rogs/yang na gsol 'debs dbyangs su gyer nas mkha' dbyings der 'jim sku'i ngang tshul gyis cer re ma 'o/ngas dang / khrung khrung gi 'phur shul du re sgug gi sems pa zab pas/nga dang mtho sgang gi dpyid dpal gyis/khyed kyi lang chodar lha bas shugs kyi gzugs brnyan bskrun bzhin mo da la/nga dang gangs ljongs kyi dpyid rlung gis/khyed kyi mi tsher mdun bskyodad kyi shugs glu gyer bzhin mo da/yid 'ong ma/khu sim sim gyi mtshan mo/ der/zla ba'i gtam rgyud kyis gsang ba stodag tu 'khyer zhing /dmar rjen gyi zhal lta ga baphra sa pa'i 'khun sgra/'jam rlung gi ram 'degs dang 'bo gas te /mi kha'i spang gcadangs kyi mtha' nas yang mthar 'phur rung /ci zhig gis bzi ba'i khyed rang 'dab rgyas kyi pad dkar ltar/nga'i dran rig gi mtsho mo'i rlabs ngogs su/yang nas bskyar du 'dzum shig shig gis bo la ro/na ci/—128—

r+sha/da ga/shā ༵ /sgrog gu med kyang /brtse ba de dang 'dzum mdangs de'i dbang gis/'o/ blo ga dang mo glo ga rgyud skud bzhin sbrel stabs/nga'i lus po bde snang gi bdud rtsis myos song ba 'dra la/khyed kyi sems pa sprin gseb kyi sta ga 'char la yan yang thang //

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/nywasnon pa'i gseb tu/ljon pa'i gseb tu/ljon pa ltar mang ba'i 'dab chags kyi re sgug thar thor/so/ ma'i mchan khung lhaṭag na gsang bas bskungs/the thog med pa'i sbrang char ni ljon pa'i lha rje ltar lo ma skam po dag dang lhan du mig sdonge bawi)la/brlan gsher gyi sprin pa ljid thod de'i 'dabs na/gnas nges med kyi sdon khyi de tshon po zhig la rmis/sprin pa ljid bo sa gzhi ljid bo'i brang khar nyil dus/ngon pa mdang stong la yul ljongs kyi bslu brid nag po phogaston kha'i zing 'tshub nang 'dab chags dang sdong lo lag gdang 'brel nas 'phur batraṭa/sngo na pa dang sngo na khyi sgyu na pa'i gseb tu 'dab chags kyi rkang rjes 'cho la/ sprin pa ljid bo de'i 'og nad rmi lam dang bslu brid kyi rdzing bu 'khyil//

skyug bro ba'o 'dzog rten/pha ༷/la gyi gangs ri/merdzo sangs bar snang gi mkha' dbyings su/sprin dkar sham lwa yi 'dabs phro la na/dkar 'gying nger/brjid chags se/lhan shig ge ra//de ni nga'i pha yul gyi gangs ri red/de ni sgang pa bod rdzongs kyi gtsug rgyan red/de ni lo ngo stong phrag gi rma shul yin la/de ni bskal chen grangs med kyi bden dpang yang yin/shā mtha' yas rtswa thang gi 'gram sngagags su/khyed ni g.yang dkar gyi lug khyu bzhin 'dzin ma'i pang khar/skya ༷ ga lha gdakar bong bong /'od 'tsher 'tsher/sngo ma sgyu rtsal khri 'bum gyi gnang sbyin dang/da 131da

gangs spyon sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrogs / —snyan ngag grangs med kyi pha sa 〈sna na lags pas/lhag bsam du ma brtsegs pa'i lhun lnga ltar/ ches malnga sa zhig nas sprin dkar gyi bang rim la thad kyis zag 'dugasdo ra ltotes dang / mu med rgya mchotsho yi mkha' mtha' ru/khyed rang / dkar shig shig tu 'chu ba'i thegs ma dang / 'dab sbrel sbrel du rgyu ba'i gnyer rlabs/yang na/ dal ltod ltod du 'phur ba'i ngang dkar dang /'dzum rig rig tu grol ba'i pad dkar ltar /nga'i 'dren byed kyi masngo nga lam yangs sngo ra/brjid chags/lhan chags/babs zu gatra//jigangs ri ya/ nga'i pha yul gyi gangs ri kye/khyed ni dri med shel dkar gyi pho brang ltar/rang byung gi lo rgyus la ra ris kyi dri ma dben la/khyed ni rab dkar mu tig gi phang phung bzhin/mnga' thang dang rin thang la 'phel 'grib kyi zla gzugs ga la mngon/khyed ni gangs can pa'i las skal dang malnga/ sgang gi khrag rgyun yin pas/khyed kyi la rgyar 'dzad med stodabs shugs kyis khengs shing /khyed kyi snying rtsar 'jags med kyi rlabs rgyun drag tu rgod/ drag tu rgod/da dung / khyed ni/—132—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/nga'i pha mes kyi bla ri dang yang mes kyi rten mkhar yin stabs/khyed kyi lang snumar rtag brtan gyi gcadag rlabs rgyas nges pa ma zad/khyed kyi mdzes par gzi brjid dang bkrag mdangs lhag tu 'tsher bar nges/5e ma/ sgyu sangs kyi nam mkha'/mdzes sdug gi sprin dkar/lhan brjid kyi gangs ri/mu med kyi rtswa thang /dngas gtsang gi chu bo de dag thams cad ni nga'i dran 'dzin gyi zhing bto/da lags pas/kho bos ha cang rgyang ring rgyang ring gi gru kha zhig nas/nam yang 'gul med sprod sku ra gyi grib gzugs ji bzhin/pha yul gyi nam mkhar yun ring cer/pha yul gyi sprin dkar la lan mang bstod/pha yul gyi gangs ri la dran 'char bkod/da dung pha yul gyi /

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ nges don gyi rdzul skru /(sprul sku bstan 'dzin bde legs rin po cher phul/)grang shur shur gyi rlung bu ldang ba'i nangs mor/'khyag sib sib kyi kha ba 'bab pa'i chothogs /ra/mig chu las skyur ba'i phrin pa mag mongag cig dang /ag skad las 'dzer ba'i skad ngag ral 11 zhig gis/nga'i sems khams rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ltar dkrug cing /khyed kyi mi tshe rlung kha'i mar me la lha na/bden te/ nges dodan gyi sprul sku lags/pha mes kyis zhabs rjes dpar ba'i rgyang ring gi zhing khams de na/dus rabs kyi smag rum snyug pa'i gangs ljongs kyi sa gzhi'i ngos su/khyed kyi/ 'tshol snyeg gi spobs pa dang bden don gyi h+phu sgra snyan mos/nga tsho'i dgun ljongs la dpyid dpal gyi lang tsho sdon zhing /khyed kyi/ zhum med kyi snying sko bas dang zla med kyi la rgya zab mo sa/yun ring bag la nyal ba'i mi rigs de'i bsam pa'i lha glegs dkrogs/lo ngo ltong phrag gi rnam smin brdol ba'i las skal dang /mi rabs grangs med la rdzod g.yeng shor ba'i god chag skabs/—134—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/khyed kyi/ re smon gyi mngar kha dang gdung tshor gyi 'gul shugs drag pos/sa yi sprod la 'di yang 'dar mo ma sku ma byas shing /khyed kyi/ gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam dang rgud skyodab kyi bsam bya dmar 1/sa/gangs dkar gyi lha tsho gas dag ho ga sad kyi brel sha langs/khyed kyi/ rang dbang gi 'ango da sgra dang rang btsan gyi dam bca' brtan sngo sa/gnas de'i 'dab chags kyang gnyid las sad byung /gnyid las sad byung /nag thing thing gi mun pa'i kho da du/grang cang cang gi khor yug de na/khyed rang / rjon pa'i mda' kha na sbum pa'i she'u chung dang /khyed rang / bzhud kha'i nyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i rdzi glu ltar/tshe 10ga 'phar sding la rtsodags tshig gi tham ga sngar nas btab zin cing /las dbang dar drag la 'pho 'gyur gyi grib so da so mar 'khor bar nye/e red/ btsan gnon gyi mkha' ngogs su bde skyid kyi drod khol dben la/gdug rtsub kyi bathe na khang nang mnar gcadad la 'dzad mtha' med stabs/mun pa'i 'jig rten la 〉tel ba'i bsam gzhig khri phragabs mtha'i bar snang na sngar bzhin sding / sngar bzhin lding /ngo ma/ 'u thug gi lo zla'i gseb tu/sdug bsngal gyi mig chu gtan nas chad ma snudang la/dus bkag gi khrims bcad btsan 11ra/sems tshegs kyi spyodam tshig nam yang bzhag ma ca/nga bas/—135—

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chetshes 3snags bsgrigs/khyed kyi dpa' ngar la balha da pa'i me tog sna tshogs/dbyar kha med pa'i dgun gzhung 'di na'ang khra lham mer bzhad 'dugade ltar/ khrag dmar gyis bris pa'i 'o/ rgyus kyi zin chod re re/snyan ngag dang gdung yus kyi byang thang bar na 'phur zhing 'tsher skabs/bdag gi re spyodan dang shugajig ring gis sprul ba'i kha btags dkar sngo de yang /khyed kyi mdzad rjes dang zhabs rjes zung la mchod dang /nges lha na gyi sprul sku kye//
'jig rten ni 'khrul snarnyi dang tshurnyi chos mkhan yi gar stegs mim snyi4ger k+tashā/'dad ṭ+wāṃ/ shi gi yang nga pa mad pa ril rtsad ngas ga tu bdag sa sams/ ྅rtod balkogangs na/

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ bsam bya leb mo 'ga'/bka3byebakamatshams sprin gyi skag cho sa nub mthar 'phyur ba'i dben 'jam gyi sa sku/da der/ rgyang mig dang bsam gzhig gis bslus pa'i dran 'char skyar mo pha yul gyi dwangs gtsang chu mig la bsrings skabs/ a ma dran drags pa'i bla na chags kyi mig chu tshom bu 'ga' khu sim bu'i yul ljongs 'di na rbab rgyun shin tu rgod la/ zla ba shar thengs rer a ma'i re sgug gi smon tshig ljang khu/ mtho sgang gi sil rlung 'jam wa'i shugs bstan khrod nga gcig bu'i mthong dbyings su khrung khrung gi khyu tshogs dang 'gran zhing 'phur dus/ sprin pa nag po de'i mkha' ngogs na nga'i 'gyod bshags kyi lo chu ma lus gang gā bde ba'i rlabs zegs dang 'dres nas bzhur yod pa khyed kyis ma brjed grodags/gnyis/mi lo sum cu'i pham sdug khrod skyo glu rkyang rkyang la lang tsho sgron pa'i nam mkha' sngar bas rgas rkyen/ char zim dang 'ja' cho na gyi kha the ga byugs pa'i yul ljongs khra mer zhig med pa bor zin pa'i lo zla dang / de ring gi rkang rjes las gsal rung / zla bdun pa'i gser mdog gi rmi lam btus te gangs ri lha mor dgod bro slong mkhan de su/bkas/'ge/pha mes kyi gangs thang 'grim pa'i byis pa snabs lug chosas/ caster gnag gi rmig rjes las ka kha'i dbyangs rta ma nges pa'i phangs sems sku da tshad nyin sngo ra —138—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/'debs dgos na/ lo ngo brgyad rgya yar sngon gyi lo ṭ+wā ba dang da rabs kyi snyan ngag pa yodad sku the ga bsam gzhig gi a 'o/nga dam du 'brel nas sems bskyed kyi zhabs gzhas thengs gcig 'khrab dbosas ma yin nam/bzhi/rmi lam dang rtog btags kyi mngar kha bsil wa ra/ re sme na dang skyabs 'jug zab pa'i mi rigs 'di nyid/ rgyang thag ha cang ring ba'i nub mtha'i skar tshom rang gi mun nag sel ba'i slog zhur 'dod rung / 'khrul snang dang gson 'dre 'thab pa'i rab rib kyi 'jig rten 'dir/ khyi spyang lag sbrel yin pa'i skyo shas kyi ro/la dbyangs thar thodar/ sprin pa sab sib kyis bkab pa'i zla ba'i ri lnga nga gis gleng / ljadus rabs phyed sku la gyis sems pa 'tshab pa'i gdung 'thodad dang shugs glu kha skyur/ srang lam du khyi 'khyam gyis lha ga pa'i 'ur zing nam rgyun che rung/ rang nyid las mtha' skor ma rig pa'i dpon ngan tsho/ mdzes ma'i 'jo sgeg dang 'dod lha'i bcos 'dzum gyis bzi ba'i dgod sgra thag thag lud cing / ma rab mno sems kyis bskul ba'i mig 'bras ril ril lha sa/ rkang pa gsum btsugs kyi bya gzhag dang las gzhi'i 'phrin las la 'bung pa'i zin bris nag 1// 'di ga'i grags 'gul dben pa'i yul ljongs mog wa ra gangs dkar gyi 'dab ma'i yang 'dab bzhin lhab lhab lhab lhab tu yun ring zags/sheskyegamun pa ha cang gnag pa'i gdan 'dre'i mtshan gzhung der lcags rgyang dang zangs rgyang gis gru bzhi bskor ba'i za zi'i khor yug 'di na/ mi rigs kyi brtse sems drod rlabs su bdod ba'i sems pa grangs med cig 'khyag 'dar dang grang 'dar khrod lo zla zas su mid cing rnag khrag skom la rol dus/ rta lcag dang slog —139—

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyug gi tshag sgras gnas de'i ri klung yang 'dar mo ma mo ma byed cing / da dung log spyod dang kha bral ring lugs kyi gshed sgra sdir ldir zlo ba'i las mkhan tshos/ gdug rtsub kyi mig 'bras dmar 'bur 'bur du bgrad thengs rer/ nyam chung gi tshe srog ji tsam zhig drag rlung gi spu grir lha na mo da pa red lags/kye ma kye hud/ zla snang dang nyi rlabs dben pa'i nga'i 'jig rten gyi mig chu dmar po sdug yus kyi dbyangs 'gros dang 'ar+sha gas te yar klungs gtsang po'i bzhur rgyun la snyeg skabs/ mdza' cad sngar nas 'das pa'i ngang mo kher rmas des/〈sna gasna ga shugs kyis deb kyin nga dzarware las dbang la gdung sems kyi mkha' lam yun ring gshags pa ngo mtshar mi che'am/bdun/do dgong dag pa'i zhing gi gru zur gang sar 'od lnga'i slog zhu dgu tshigs kyi mig kong bzhin 'dzum la/ lding lding du 'khrol ba'i 'gyur khug khrod/ nga'i grogs po dang zhe mthun gyi na zla tsho zur mig gi bslu brid 'og 66lha sa'i sbi rag zhabs tag bod rang btsan gtsang ma/ a pha'i ro bzi dgos red/ tshang ma shor zin pa red mi de ltar mtshan mo dang mtshan mo ra ros bskyal zhing lo zla dang lo zla mig chus 'tsho/ a/ nga'i pha yul gyi rma kha rnying rul gyis gtses shing nga'i mi rigs kyi dung snang kha shul las grang / yin yang spyan ras gzigs bskal rgyar spyan gzims mdzad/ cadad dpag med/ mar me'i codad kyis bzi/ shu/ lha chang chung dag gis su zhig skyodab thub bam 1

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/'acosag pa kun legs/(1)tshul 'chodas dang gasku bsku'i mo lang lha da pa'i 'jig rten gyi gru kha 'di ru/ khyed rang mi med kyi 'brog dgon dang nyam nga ba'i dur khrod steng 'gyur khug gis dben pa'i mi rkyang rkang gling zhig 'bud kyin/ su zhig la skyod shas kyi mgur dbyangs shur shur 'then te zing zing gi 'khor ba 'dir rdzogs tshig 'debs dgos pa'i rting skul mdzad/(2)ban bun gyi skug rdul 'phyur ba'i gnang rabs kyi 'phrang lam steng / khyed kyis rkang rjen mar babo/da pa'i zhabs rjes gaskusten 'o/ yig drug gi gzugs brnyan dang lhan du brag jo ra 'dzum pas/ skra sku kha bas gasku gas pa'i rgan rabs chotshos smon lam dang rdo dkar bsres pa'i lab rtse khyed la btod/(3)khyed rang mda' mo gzhu rgyud la sbreng te sngo na khyi la sil sgra grags thengs rer/ sems can khri 'bum gyi rnam shes dag zhing la 'phangs rung / mun nag gi rngams kha mthug pa'i khor yug 'di na bla sprul dang ri spyang khros pa'i ngu skad lhang lhang du grags/(4)khyed rang dug tshal gyis lus wa btums shing sprang 'o/ra nang rtsam skya stsodang da 141da

gangs nyu3 3 brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/zhor/ srang lam dang 'du tshogs gang mang nyul skabs/ gtam sbyor gyi dbu 'phang mkhrod ba'i rgyal dbang chodas rjes sdigs mdzub kyi tshig mda' grangs med dang lhan du phu nu'i la rgya la dmar gshags kyi lcags ri 'then/(5)ma ni dang bsang dud bsdebs pa'i yul ljongs der nang dme'i dar lcog lheb lheb tu g.yos rkyen/ khyed rang 'bras ser gyi gling skor na a rag gi dam bi sngas gzhir brten te sku zhabs dang dge bshes su tshang nang dus chad kyi cad rtsed mo la bar sgug pa ra zhugs dang sbi rakā nyags/khyed kyis bud med nyi stong gi brang gzhung brtol ba'i 'dod chags kyi bzi gtam dmar po nyin thor btab pa nas bzung / mtsho stodad kyi ngang ser yan chad khyed kyi tshe sku ga la rgol ba'i gshed ma sdugs/gamo dad kyi bsil g.yab cadag dug gsum gyi tsha thodad snga sku ba sku ba 'bar ba'i khyim pa'i gnas khang gru bzhi'i nang / khyed kyis gsang sngaḍa kyi gdam ngag dmar rjen pha rgan nyams chen la lnga la gyis 'thosams skabs/ boto 'othog gi cad tsha smin pa'i lcam sring zung nas pa pha the bkag bcug( ༵'i las rnyog gang sar grags pa e dran/'brug pa kun legs/stong nyid kyis myos pa'i bzi bo khyed rang mun nag gi gting rum 'di ru ci zhig 'asnu la/'brug pa kun legs/sprang po dbyug thogs khyed rang ci yang med pa'i ri zhol de nas gang du chas song ba 6spun//da 142da

skyug rgyo ba'i 'dzog rten/kher rkyang gi mno sems/bkatsungebakabadag ni 'phag sa pa'i ye shes dang so skye'i rnam rtog gi 'phro 'dur gzhigs pa'i le lo'i gtan tshigs smra ba zhig 'asnga da rung / gnyid mthug pa'i mi rigs shig gi bsam yul las 'das pa'i thodad chag rtsab hral der/ dung sems kyis bslus pa'i dbang lnga dbang med du phyogs rkyen phyi dro der sha dang rus pa'i brtse gdung gi mar me kong bu gang / rang gi nus tshod kyi tshe srog phra mo'i 'phag 'tshag dang sdong ste/ dkon mchog gi 'jim sku'i 'dzum mdangs la 'bad pas gtor la 'brel dus/ dpa' rgod tsho'i dur byang la 'khreng pa'i mig chu khyodar ba gang pha sa'i sprin dkar gyi zhabs cosag nas bsil bzhin sku da/gnyis/dbul 'o/ngas kyi dka' sdug dang sku nam pa'i las dbang gis mnar ba'i bdag gi yab yum zung ni/ ltag 'og gi dus rabs gang du'ang btsan po'i bka' baspo da dang / tshul 'chodas mkhan wa'i zhabs phyir chodas blangs 'o/da pa'i gnam cadag gi bran g.yog drung drung zhig yin stabs/ chog shes dang bzod bsran gyi dri ngad 'thul ba'i dben thang gi ri grong 'di ru mi rabs du ma'i las skal gyi yig drug sdusas pa yang bgrang gis ga la langs/gas/ma/ a pa'i bka' brda dang skyed ma'i re 'dun med pa'i bdag gi mdun 'gros ni/ lko bzhud kyi khrung khrung kher ldom gyi smon 'dun dang / skyabs 'jug 'ba' da 143da

gangs nyurte sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/zhig yin la zing zing gi 'jig rten 'dir dung dung gi bsam blo'i rgyags phye zhig 'tshol phyir/ ha cang skyo zhing / ha cang ngal zhing / 'grul bzhud de'i rin thang sku/da tshad ches mtha' mjug gi gtan tshigs shig la bsgu la/ red ya/ char rlung rgod cing na bun stug pa'i nam zla'i 'gyur bag de mi myong tshe/nyi 'od dro zhing 'ja' tshon gyi kha dog bkra ba'i yar klungs kyi spang thang de yang lo ngam rta rdzi'i mi rgyud kyi jo ba cha kho nar nges/bzhi/bcos ma'i 'dzum mdangs kyis bslus pa'i de ring gi spyi tshogs ni yod tshad yid gtad bral ba'i gcan gzan gyi do ra dang mtshungs na/ rang rigs dang spun zla zhes pa'i kha g.yang snyan mo de yang rang gi khyim gzhis dang bu rabs tsho'i btags don kho nar zad pa spyodas ma dgos rung / mu mthud mi rigs kyi mgrin tshab pa gcig dang mang cho gas kyi sne khrid gcig la mabo ho/ngas kyi rmi lam smad bzhin pa'i nga chosas/ mun nag la gamo la gyin mun nag gi sa la 'dun la 〈snad rgal gyi rgyang bskyod byed bzhin pa'i ltar snang dang gsog gsob kyi lag rjes shig 'acadag shin 'dug lda nga tshos so so'i cho rigs la macod sems dkon pa'i gang dran dran gyi lta ba g.yodan thal zhig gtsigs su 'dzin pa ni/ wa mo ra la bsnyun mi dbo sa pa dang ra rgan wa la mi 'jigs pa'i bden rtags su dbyin ji'i bu mo'i 'phongs 'gor lteb sul ci tsam yodad min yang ngag 'don byed nus/ tha ba mi bzad dang mi rigs nyams nyes kyi lham gar na bun bzhin 'thibs rung / rang gces 'dzin kyi 'du shes kun nas blangs te gangs ri'i pho gsar dag dngul lor gyi mi tshe 'tshol bar nub phyogs rgad mo'i pang khar smon spro dad gsum gyi stangs stabs bsgyar la brel rkyen/snu/ mtshan lce yis macesad pa dang sgyu mtshan snyim pas bkur ba'i jom lnga ma gyi skusal —144—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/gsar ngang gis galta da/ a la la/ mo mabo pho gdong gi bstan pa dar ba'i rda sa'i gru kha ya/ drag a shu re/ tshul ldan gyi mi rithos shig gis de ltar tshul min gyi lugs srol sna tshogs la spang blang gi dacadad zhib gang yang med par tshad las 'das pa'i thetol rgyugs byas pa des/ da mus gzhi nas nub cadags pa snu sa/ nga chorta sngar gyi snyems chung drang bden gyi 'dzin stangs las gnas dbyung btang zin cing / de las rdzog ste dang po lha dang gnyis pa mi/ gsum pa 'dre ru 'dod pa sogs rang tshugs dang gtan bab med pa'i dkyus ma'i sdodam tshig cig the bar+sha sa byas pa des 'u tsho'i yang snying lhang la 'bud zin pa ma yin nam/medan/klad pa rdo mkhregs dang rang dono gyi rtogs pa lam du grol ba'i gangs skyid kyi lha ma chen rnams/ tshul 'chodas kyi mdzad 'phrin rgyas shing dmangs gcadan gyi ye sangs rgyas skabs/ dmar po'i mkha' 'acad ma dang pe cing gi na chung mas sgeg nyams dang 'dzum mdangs kyis btegs pa'i dar dkar de/ dus rabs rdzog 'gros kyi ral gri rnon po zhig dang 'dra bar gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig tshal ba stong phrag la bkad pa'i 'jigs dngangs yer yer/ nga dang srong btsan sgam po'i rmi lam las macadan gsum ma yin par sna ga daskaton mdzadag gis mkhyen//

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ drug pa'i tshes bzhi/bkatsungebakadrug pa'i tshes bzhir/ drang srong lhung ba ri dgas kyi gnas na/ go ta ma'i zab zhi'i gdam ngag dmar rjen lnga sde bzang po'i khrag rtsa'i sbub kha re rer rlabs phreng bzhin du 'atso / de nas bzung 'jig rten khams na brtse sems kyi ljang myug 'bus pa'i gtam rgyud gleng /gagis/drug pa'i tshes bzhir/ dbu rtse sbug pa'i slong du chos grogs tshos lhag bsam gyi lag gdang dam du 'brel/ dga' dbo da kyi rlung rta mkha' la spur/ lha rgyal 'then/ ki hi hi/ 6bod rang btsan yin/nya de ni dus rabs gcig gi 'thab rtsod kyi dbu khyud yin par brjod/gas/ma/drug pa'i tshes bzhir/ pe cing gi bshas ra chen snu ra tshe sku ga 'bum phrag gi mgo bo dum bur bcad/ gsar 'god pas/ 'gro ba mi'i thob thang mi 'dug zer/ bsam blo bas/ mar khe si'i gzhung lugs rtsab hral du 'grel/bzhi/drug pa'i tshes bzhir/ rda ram sa lar skyabs bajo la gyi 'o/ zla rings/ srang lam gang sar mā cang gi ༷teg sgra grags/ sku da tshad sems shugs chag pa e yin/bka' blo na khri pas/ spyi mthun gyi bsku da nams ma smin pa'i gtan tshigs 'jo ga/—146

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/sems pa bza bo/1dran sems kyi thir rtses yang nas bskyar du bskul ba'i snying gtam gyi mtshon ris bkra mo stong 'dang gi dbugs ring nar nar dang 'grogs te 'khyug dus/bsil rlung gi rol sgeg rtsen pa'i dben 'jam gyi gzhi der/ brtse dung / rmid mi tshar ba'i rmi lam zlum po zhig dang 'dra bar zla ba'i codad stodar gyi gzhi thig las rtse zhing 'phyo/ brjed dka' de khyed lags na/ dran sla ba yang khyed kho na/tsho tshe sku ga gi lang chod dar la bab dus/ mi yul dus bzhi'i brje bsgyur gyi zlos gar mthong byung / dus der snying gi gang bu'i lto ba rgyas shing khrag rtsa dmar po'i lding shugs 'phar dgos pa brtse dung gi gsar stobs dang lang tsho'i gshed shugs los yin/ 'khor stangs de'i rkyen gyis/ rang nyid la rang dbang med pa dang rnam shes la kha 'o/ ma 'chun par/ chodad rgal gyi dbyangs 'bo sa shig gis ri klung brtol/ de ni mi yul gyi dpyid rlung yin srid la/ de ni bla srog gi 'phag 'tshag kyang yin nges/ grib bsil snum sngotsware 'chang blo la na/ chu skyes kyi bzhin dpal la 'gran bzod pa'i yul ljongs shig dmar gong gong ngang zil thigs kyi do shal bsnabs skabs/ dung zla'i dus tshigs khe nas khyed rang bzhad kha phye na snyam/ gtsang chu'i bzhur sgra khe nas khyed kyi snying gtam skyodar na sems/ —147—

gangs myo sh+lau brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ji'aja' tshon gyi kha dog la dam por 'jus te/ bar sna nga gi dkyil 'khor du tshangs rgyur chas pa'i snga char/ gro thig gi mdzes sag spad pa'i phye leb du ma 1——pa ///tre la ringa'ajam rlung gi gshog sgror 'khyud de dal ba dal bur 'phur/ thams cad zhi lhing gi skal ba ldan pa'i stong khams su/ sdug bsngal gyi brag rdor sra mkhregs kyi mtshan nyid dben zhing / dran sems kyi rgya mtshor 'jigs rung gi rlabs sgra dkon/ shog dang 'jig rten gyi rdzu bag la zhen pa log pa'i srog chags tha dag zang zing dang bsun snang bral ba'i bar snang ljang khu'i ljongs su/sa srod ni/ gsang ba yod tshad kyi dus tshigs lags na/ sdong lo dang lhan du rkang stobs kyi ldem myur bskyod kyin bsil rlung gi shugs bstan dang smra sgo yi brjod don bsres te sus kyang the gtogs med pa'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig tu brtse dung gi rgyal sras la gsol ka btod dang / gdung sems kyi rje bcun sgrol mar phyi phyag 'tshol dang / phyime lce'i tsha rlabs las rgod pa'i drod snang zhig gis/ ston mjug gi mtshan mo'i grang shur dum bur bcad stabs/ sems pa dang sems pa 'brel ba'i 'tshub shas/ rang nyid gang du 'grengs ba yang cha mi 'tshal/ khor yug gis ched du bsto ba'i gnang sbyin de longs spyod 'dod na/ phan tshun dam du 'thams shing / yod tshad gcig tu bsres dang / da dung thim mdog gi mtshon rtsi bkra ba'i mchu sgros dmar pos/ bsil tog las mngar ba'i bro zhim ster ba bden du rlom na/ shugs kyis gzhibs dang bzi bzi bar/ gcig byas na /—148—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/rtogs gzhig gi mtshar snang /smospyir cho med pa'i 'jig rten 'dir cho med pa'i grub mtha' zhig gsar rtsodam byed dbo sa pa las gtan tshigs sku da tshad kyi sne mo ra 'jus te mi'i rigs spyi mthun gyi las dbang la bcadas bsgyar byed 'the da pa ni dka' tshegs thams bcad kyi phung por sgrub/ ༄ 2ma smin pa'i shes rab ni skyod bsun dang zhen 'o/ga gi 'kho ra 'gul a ma lags na sgo snang dang bag phebs 'dod pa'i gang zag tha dag ston mjug gi gling kha'i nang du 'cham gseng mi gnang bar ///bud med g.yo yi bdag nyid red ces skyes chen dam pa'i gsung rab nang gsal ngo ra 'kho da na 'o/ skyes ma rab kyi chodas nyid la da dung yang sangs rgyas kyis gsal kha bdodad mi 'dug kho bos rang nyid kyi bden pa la yid ches dang gsol 'debs rtse gcig tu byed pa las de min 'dra sku gzhan zhig gi drung du tshul 'asnu sa kyi sdudas gar 'khrab dathodas dodan mi 'dug snyam/5sangs rgyas ji ltar mthu rtsal che rung 'bo ba'i khams bsgyur mi thub pa da 149da

gangs nyu3 sgya brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/dang tshan rig ji ltar yar lnga na yin yang / mi'i sems kyi gsang ba bswā la mi thub pa des 'jig rten gyi mthar thug ni masngo na med dang / su zhig gis bsdodams tshig byed pa'i nus pa med par gtan tshigs /tres khag theg nus/(so/ga pa'i lam la mu med phyir nyizhes rigs pa tshad thub kyi lungs la 'dren yang bzang po'i las la mtha' med pa'i don dngos gzhan zhig kyang de'i ldog khyodags kyi lho sa su grub na/ de nyid dmigs bsal du gar dbo sa rgyu mtshan gyis stongs/7sangs rgyas chos lugs ni shākya mu zhes dasngo sa wa'i gnas lugs dang sgo bstun nas sems kyi rang bzhin la 'grel bshad brgyab pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs shig yin pa bden dodan lags kyang de las zhan pa'i rin thang yan ga ba zhig rgyag dgos don e yod/8sna tshogs 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sna tshogs pa'i ya mtshan dngo sa byung grangs las 'das nges na/ de nyid rgyu mtshan du bgrang nas skye ba phyi ma sku da pa'i grub byed babo da pa ni rig pa mun 'chodam gyi ce la 'dun zhig las bstan pa yun gnas la 'bad pa'i thabs 'phrul ga la yin/9 rnam mkhyen ni chodas lugs kyi bshad sku la gcig dang chodas lugs kho na'i nang bed spyod dgos pa'i rig rtsal gyi brda chad gcig red/ gal srid de rigs srid ro/na gyi dbo sa mkho ra dmigs nas 'chod ba dasngo sa kyi nang rgyang sgro ga byas tshe/dmag dpon tshos kyang lag gi mtshon cha bskyur nas nam mkha' stong par re ltos 'chang ba'i glen rtags lha na mi srid pa min/—150—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/10mdang dgong nga la rmi lam zhig rmis byung / skam la rid pa'i rnal 'byor mi la ras pa gang des/ sprin dkar gyi rta phor bcibs te bdag gis mthong dbyings nas skad shugs chen pos/ wa ye gangs spyon/ khyod rang da dung gnyid las sad med dam zhes gsungs/ khong gis ngo nag mthug mthug ngang / khyod kyis e shes/ngas de snga sha skam lpags skam chags chags dka' sbyong byed pa de rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob phyir min/ de ni phyi rabs kyi gangs can pa tshos sgyid lug dang sos dal la ma g.yeng par dus rabs kyi 'gyur khug la stabs bstun byed rgyu'i rting bskul yin zhes gsungs/ de 'phral |( 11sa gti mug gi sgrib gasku/gas gshags pa dang 'brel ki ring zhig btab pa yin/ 'on kyang nga'i mtha' 'khor gyi mi rnams da dung yang gnyid las mi sad/ zhib tu blta skabs kho tsho tshang ma da gzod 'gyig gi mi la gzugs 'gyur byas zin 'dug a ma ma/ nga gcig pus 'jig rten chen po 'di ji ltar skyong thub bam/11nī khres/ dkon mchog gshegs song / mi gson po sus skyobs thub bam zhes skyod ngal gyi 'khun sgra bsgrags pa dang / dbyig gnyen gyis/ dpang 'gyur skye bo phal cher zad gyur cing / zhes mi'i rigs kyi las dbang la sems 'tshab byed pa gnyis bde chad kyi mcho na stangs mi 'dra ba tsam las shes bya'i rnam gzhag gi gzhi gcig la 'grel kyin par snang / des na mi'i rigs kyi 'byung 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas ni mi'i rigs rang nyid kyis bskyed bsrings byed dgos pa'i phul byung gi mi sna zhig las/ de min grangs med gsum gyi snga mo la nas sku da tshad mchodag tu gyur zin pa'i rdzu 'phrul can des tshab mcho na byed mi thub na/ da nas bzung rang cag gangs can pa'i 'phul byung gi sangs rgyas sam thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdags gzhi de yang / mi rigs gdod ma'i dus skabs kyi mun 'thom gyi bsam blo'i 'du —151—

gangs nyu3 gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/shes pa'i bcings rgya las bamo la te/ spyi chodags kyi 'chorta ba dalnga sa kyi nyams myong la dzā ba bya zab cing / lag len las sbyong brdar lnga ba pa'i phul byung gi mi sna zhig la khri ston dang brtan bzhugs 'bul dgos par 'dod/12shes rab kyi yang rtser sku na pa'i mi zhig la sangs rgyas zhes tha snyad kyi bkur bsti'i me dodag gdodar ba las de las gzhan pa'i mtshan dpal gyis rgyan pa'i gachodan nu'i rnam ro/la zhig dag mi dag gi khug khyodag gang zhig tu 'phur stangs khyad par ba'i ldem myur lha da pa bdag gis ma rig codan kyang mu mthud rtag brtan gyi gcadan nu'i rnam blo la las mi sdug pa'i rga 'chi'i rnam gzhag la lha la nus na/ rten 'brel dang skad cig gi gdung sems gtsang mar gcod dgos/1 'dodad chags la 'grel bshad rgyag dpo sa pa'i gnad dodan 'phrad tshe/sems kyi 'phrul snang red ces brjod na 'tshams shos su mthong / dper na/ thig le 'chor la khad kyi gang zag de'i ltag khung la me mda' btsugs na mkha' 'gro'i lha ga'i lha khar liṅga 'phred du 'gyel nges pas so/14gnam codag gi skye thod kun gyis dkon mchodag gi 'dra sku'i drung du tshang kha shig shig ngang gsol 'debs byed pa las khong gi bka' slob la rtsis med gtong ba de rgyu rkyen gang zhig cha ma 'argang ba yin nam/15mkhas pa las las/ 66kha sang ni 'das zin pa dang / sang nyin ni ma 'ongs pa red/ khyod la gdeng stod yod pa ni de ring kho na red mi ces rang nyid kyi 'dod tshul brjod mod/ bsam blo ba ni de las ldog ste mi'i rigs dang de'i ma yum rang 'byung khams kyi tshe sku ga gi chodag ma'i byung rim dang bar gyi 'phel rgyas/—152—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/tha ma'i 'jig nyen sogs sgo kun la rtogs gzhigs dang ljongs rgyu byed dgos stabs/ nam rgyun bdag gi kun gzhi'i sngo ra 'das zin pa ni dpyid kyi 'o/ nya'i gre 'gyur gyi 'gyur khug cig dang da lta ba ni 'byung bzhi'i tsha drod snyom zhing me tog sna tshogs kyi 'dzum sgeg thodal ba'i lang tsho'i kha snga ga ljang snum zhig de mtshungs ma 'ongs pa yang 'bras bu'i nor gyi khengs pa'i 'dod 'jo'i ba mo lta bu zhig la cis ma 'du/1phyiyal ga dang 'o/ 'dab ldan par ljo na shing zhes lab dbo sa tshe me lta ga la dmigs bsal me lta ga ces pa'i tha snyad spyodad dbo sa dodan mi 'dug gal srid me tog la ljon shing zhes 'bod mi chog na me tog gi yal ga dang 'dab ma la tha snyad gas ra pa spyad de me lta ga gi yan lag dang lheb lheb ces smra dbo sa pa gtan 'khel red/17brlan gsher gang nas thog mar 'thung ba'i gzhi der srog dang rten gyi gatho thod gnas 'dug pa ni dper na mi'i kha nas chu 'thung dbo sa stabs sku ga gi gzhi rten lus kyi rdo da char chags 'dug pa dang rtsis shing gis brlan gsher rkang pa ga sa 'thung dbo sa pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rten gyi ga༄ cad smad kyi cha la mchodang /18dpyid ka shar dus rtsis shing gi the'u dmar gong gong du 'bus pa dang kham bu'i me lta ga gis 'dzum mdangs mi yul la bskyed cing / banyes gshin gyi 'dab lo g.yo ba'i phye leb tshos rang dbang gi gshog ris bya lam gyi ngogs su ci gar bri sa/so/na kyang / dus tshigs de ni nga rang sems pa lha phra sa kyi gnas skabs yin/ gang yin zer na snyan ngag pa zhig gis/ dar ma'i na chodad dbyar gyi me+e lta ga dang / mdzes pa'i bkrag mdangs dgung gi 'ja' chodan yin/ zhes 'jig rten gyi gdong lpags —153—

gangs rje(na gyi brtsams chos phyogs bsgrigs/ dbral zin pas sku /19so/ gsar tshes gcig la rten 'brel gyi bzhin 'dzum dbo da shig shig lo mjug gi tshes gcig la rnam rtog gi ngo gdong nag rdzub rdzub/ skye skar gyi nyin mor dga' ston gyi glu skad sangs sangs dang 'das mjug gi dgong mor ngu skad ral ral sgrog kye ma 'jig rten ni de 'dra'i cha mi lha mas pa zhig dang mi yang ci 'dra'i sna bsun mi 'khel ba'i glang rgan khyodang ba zhig red/ gal te bcadas su med pa'i skye bo sngo na ma zhig yod pa'i dbang du btang na gang zag tshos bag chags dang chodad 'dzin gtan nas med pa'i glen rtags 'di 'dra zhig dus rtag tu bstan srid dam/2༷'dod chung chog shes zer ba de ni chos lugs kyi bsam blos dbul phongs mi ser la sems gso gtong ba'i skad cha stodang pa zhig red la/ gna' bskyal bo btsugs kyi lugs srol de yang mun 'thom rjes lus kyi spyi tshogs shig nang mtho rim mi snas dbul phongs mi ser gyi bsam blor stangs 'dzin byed pa'i lcags sgrog shig rang red/21skad cha ni kha nas 'chad pa'i brda masnu na zhig la gtan 'khel zin rung lkug pa tshor u tshugs kyis skad cha lag pas chad pa'i brda mtshon slob dgos don gang /22tshul 'acodas ni mi'i rigs kyi bo/da chag dang dmag 'khrug gi 'byung khungs gtso bo lags na ji srid tshul 'chos la gdong gtad ma nus bar de srid 'dzam gling zhi bde dang mi'i rigs kyi phugs bsam masngo na 'gyur mo nga mi srid/—154—

skyug gyo ba'i 'dzog rten/2 sangs rgyas cesas lugs ni sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la phab thub mkhan gyi mār+shas lugs gcig pu de red/sangs rgyas chos lugs ni 'byung 'gyur 'jig rten 'di'i stsodab gso rig pa zhig red/sangs rgyas mār+shas lugs ni tshan rig gis dbye zhib byas mi tshar ba'i bskal thosan zhig red//(nang don de da dung mjug sgril med/)

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos 37gas bsgrigs/ gnya' khri btsan po/lha ri gyang tho'i 'ja' skas las bab te btsan thang sgo bzhir zhabs rjes dpar dus/ gtan nas rig ma myong ba'i rdzi bo tshil dreg 'gas khyed rang bod la g.yag drug gi rje bor bkur ba'i dus rabs kyi khri stodan brjid po bon rgan tsho'i cho ga ltar/ gong po ri'i lab rtse'i rlung rta dang mnyam du bsdebs/nyi mar sngar las bkrag mdangs 'tsher ba'i sham 1ཿgra gangs 'dabs nas khyim gzhis the na smod zhig gi tshe sku/ga gsar du 'bus pa'i skye skar gyi lha/ gzhas snyan mo/ yar mo/ klungs thang gi pang nas 'kho la zhing / sham chu'i zegs ma dang lhan du mkha' la 'thor skabs mtho sgang gi byang thang gang sar 'jag skya'i phon po ltar sil bur yar ba'i nus rgyud kyi tsho khag du ma lha chen gang zhig gi 'jigs zil gyi khro skad las 'dar ba'i rkang chung / las dbang gi spang khug gcig tu 'a17mas/red ang / lo ngo stong phrag du mar lha sgrung gi rmi lam las 'jam pa'i sbra nag leb mo'i pha khyim la gser rtsi 'byug dus/ lwa ba trul sngo khyodan pa'i 'acadag phrug mang pos khyed kyi mtha' 'khor na rdzi gzhas dang la glu gling bur dkrol nas me tog dang rtsam pa gnam la gajo ra/ da dung skra dkar gyi ral ba 'dzing pa'i rgan rabs tshos brag ri mthon po'i dbu rtser bskrun pa'i yum bu bla mkhar la rgyang blta byed chodar lha yul gyi mchodad rten sa la zags pa'i u tshugs lan mang byed/gang ltar/ khyed kyi ngo mtshar ba'i byad gzugs dang thun min gyi rig stobs/ mang bkur gyi dbang thang dang bsod nams kyi las skal re re gna' bo'i mi tsho gas kyi dbus na lud cing 'phyur bas/ la las khyed ni gong ma lha las bab —156—

skyug rgyo ba'i 'dzog rton/pa'i gnyan btsan cig dang / 'ga' res khyed ni 'phags pa'i yul nas lhags pa'i dmag dpon zhig gzhan yang ri sgang mtho sar 'khrungs pa'i rdzus skyes shig sogs mag mo ga gi 'aro/da tshul du ma'i sku lang gangs seng dkar mo'i gad rgyangs dang mnyam du bsdebs nas yar klungs gtsang wa'i dba' rlabs dang lhan du 'phyur/dus de nas bzung / spur rgyal gong ma'i gdung rgyud kyi khye'u btsas shing yar lha sham wa ra lha gasku la gyi dmar mchodad phul bas/ ki srod 'debs pa'i snyan ngag gi sgya rtsal cadag mar sprum la/ lha g.yag dkar sngo sa sa nag bcadag pa'i sta bo na bgyid skobs/ 'bri mo'i 'jo 'jo yi bzho dbyangs 'gu ga pa'i spyang grung rnyed zin pas dngul gyi bzho lung sked par 'alha gas pa'i lugs srol yang dar yod las che/'on kyang / khyed rang skye skar dang skyes tshes mi gsal ba'i ri mgo de nas thol gyis 'byon zhing / slar yang khyed rang bang so dang dur byang med pa'i yul gru de nas yud kyis bzhud stabs/ btsan sngo na rim gyi 'o/ tshigs 'chodal ba'i dkar chag zad do de'i gzhigs rtsod da lta'i bar du yang sa mtho'i ri klung la brag cha 'khyil//

gangs nyu3 sh+lau brtsams chos phyosnags bsgrogaso/ rtswa thang gi zhogs pa/skya rengs 'dren pa'i 'o/ nyas mun pa'i gshed ma rgyang ring rgyang ring gi gnas su bskrad pas shar mtha'i skar chodags dag re re bzhin codad lam lam gyi dbugs rgyun phra mo bsdu chodar rim pas sngo sangs ma'i mo la bas bsgribs/ dbyar zla ra ba'i malngasto sgang gi chodags pa'i mkha' dbugs ni ha cang dwangs shing bsil bas rang byung khams kyi skye dngos dang srog ldan yod do cog la sngar na med pa'i gson shugs gsar 'acadal zhig dang / 'dzad mtha' med pa'i stodabs shugs yan ga ba zhig ster gyin sku da stabs kho ra yug gi rtswa rtse'i zil thigs rnams kyang rlung sil bu'i 'thodas dang bstun nas 'dar mo ma mo ma ngang 'dzin ma'i phang bar lhang /mi ring bar 'od zer bye ba brgya phrag gis spud pa'i rta ljang dbang po de/thun gsum rmi lam las dwangs ba'i phra la gyis dal bu dal bur mtha' yas rtswa thang gi ngos su 'phros skabs/ sngo ser dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i me tog sna tshogs brel brel 'tshub 'tshub ngang / rang gi gnyen 'jam 'dab ma'i lteb khug nang 'khyil ba'i chu thigs rnams lta na sdug pa'i ze'u 'bru'i mkhur cho sa la 'byug 'byug lan 'ga' byas te/ rkang drug gazlo na nur lang tsho'i sgeg nyams cadam pa'i sta bo na byed bzhin gda'/skabs der bdag gi gom pa'i 'degs 'jog kyang rang dbang med par mu mtha' mi mngon pa'i rtswa thang gi phyogs su bsgyur dgos byung / ltos dang / mar gad zhun ma'i khu ba 'byug 'dra'i pha yul gyi rtswa thang de ni/ sgyu rtsal mkhan wa'i spar ris las sgyu na dka' zhing snyan ngag mkhas pa'i smyug rtse las 'khrungs par dka' —158—

skyug bro ba'i 'dzog rten/stabs/ bdag gi kun sna ga gi byed sngo yang re zhig cadags pa'i sil rlung dang mnyam du sdeb kyin skabs 'gar rtswa thang gi mkha' dbyings su 'phur nas phye leb bu mo dang mnyam du rtsen/ mtshams rer rtswa sgyu na gyi gseb tu 'dzul nas bu nag bo ga bo ga dang lhan du rol/ da dung lan rer bung ba gzhon nu dang sgyu glu len bzhin mu mthud rtswa thang gi mdzes sdug la zhen cing chags/a la la/ de lta bu'i mtshar sdug gi dpal bar ba'i yul ljongs des bdag gi 'dren byed zung gi brtan pa cig car du 'astodag pas/ kho thodas dus yun ring po zhig nim ljang rtswa thang gi 'gram du krong nger langs nas bsdad/ slo bur kha chu gas nges med nas ldang ba'i bsil bu zhig bdag gi rna lam du 'ur sgra dang bcas ldang bar brten/ yun ring nying 'jags kyi gnyid du yur ba'i gdod ma'i rtswa thang de'ang dus rabs kyi the nga sgra ci zhig gis 'tshub sha bslangs ba ltar/ rtswa ljang dang me tog gi sdong rkang yod tshad mgo lcog ldem ldem byed pa dang lhan du bsung zhim gyi dri ngad dag kyang sdudags bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'thul bzhin 'dugalho sa dang mu mtha' med pa'i rtswa thang dang ྅ zhing sangs pa'i nam mkha' gnyis yug gcig tu sbrel 'dug pas skabs shig ring nga rang gang du mo da pa'ang cha mi 'tshal/ codan tang / ha cang rgyang ring rgyang ring zhig nas rdzi thod gachodan nus 'bus pa'i gling bu'i skad sgra lhang lhang du thos tshul la dpags na/ nga rang da dung yang rtswa thang gi dbus su slebs med pa stodags thub/der rten kho bos cung zad ngal gso dang sbrags sngo thing thing gi rtswa rtsi'i steng lus lnga gan rkyal du nyal nas sdodad skabs/ nga'i mkha' dbyings na cho na masnga ga mi gcig pa'i phye ma leb dkar dmar du mas 'tshang kha shig shig gis 'phur sding byed pa dang / lhag par gser gyi rang mdog 'dra ba'i sbrang nor bu'i tshogs rnams 'ung 'ung gi skad sgra sgrog bzhin/ gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyi me tog gi ze'u 'bru 'thu tshul de rig tshe/ rtswa thang gi mi dmangs cho sa dka' spyad 'bad bce na dang —159
